Executive & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Serve as the primary delivery interface with senior leaders, including CIOs, VPs, and CXOs.
  • Tailor communications effectively for executive audiences.
  • Build and maintain strong sponsor relationships through transparency and credibility.
  • Navigate competing stakeholder priorities with maturity and emotional intelligence.

Vendor & Partner Leadership

  • Lead vendor and partner delivery activities.
  • Hold implementation partners accountable for: Contractual commitments, Delivery milestones and Quality expectations
  • Identify vendor risks early and recommend corrective actions.
  • Ensure vendor activities align with overall project goals and governance standards.

PMO Influence & Mentorship

  • Model mature delivery leadership and professional behaviors for Project Managers and Coordinators.
  • Mentor PMs through influence, example, and informal coaching.
  • Share lessons learned and delivery insights to strengthen PMO practices.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of Delivery processes, Governance practices and PMO standards

Responsibilities may vary within the range of tasks and activities described.

Decision Authority & Escalation

  • Full authority for project-level delivery decisions, prioritization, and risk mitigation.
  • Responsible for preparing and presenting decision-ready recommendations to sponsors and steering committees.
  • Escalates cross-project, systemic, or portfolio-level risks to the Portfolio Manager.
  • Operates as a trusted advisor within executive decision forums.

Financials & Budget

  • Provide oversight and guidance on project financials for assigned initiatives.
  • Identify financial risks and trends as visibility improves.
  • Partner with Project Managers to improve budget tracking, forecasting practices and financial narratives
  • Support effective communication of financial risks and trade-offs to senior leaders.
  • Contribute to increased financial maturity through coaching, standardization, and lessons learned.

Success Measures

The successful Senior Project Manager will demonstrate:

  • Predictable delivery of complex initiatives with minimal surprises.
  • Executive confidence and trust in delivery leadership.
  • Early identification and mitigation of risks and dependencies.
  • High-quality escalation materials that enable efficient decision-making.
  • Positive influence on PMO delivery maturity and team capability.

  • PMP, Scrum Master, or similar project management certification strongly preferred.
  • Ability to travel 10% or less as needed.

Knowledge & Experience

  • Experience leading complex, multi-system initiatives involving data platforms, integrations and enterprise applications
  • Ability to coordinate effectively across technical and business teams without serving as the functional subject matter expert.
  • Proven ownership of project financials, including budget planning, forecasting, variance management and financial reporting
  • Strong proficiency with Smartsheet as a primary planning and tracking tool.
  • Experience with project management platforms such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Asana and Azure DevOps.
  • Understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies and traditional predictive project management approaches.
  • Working knowledge of: data governance concepts, financial planning processes and system optimization practices.
  • Demonstrated success managing distributed, cross-functional teams.
  • Highly organized and adaptable with the ability to prioritize effectively, manage competing demands, and perform under pressure.

Skills & Personal Qualities

Leadership & Influence

  • Demonstrated emotional intelligence and the ability to adapt communication styles based on audience and situation.
  • Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence outcomes without formal authority.

  • Exceptional verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex topics clearly to technical terms, business stakeholders, vendors and executive leadership
  • Strong written communication skills, including executive status reporting, steering committe materials, decision ready presentations.

jobs.description:
The Role

We’re looking for a Marketing Operator to support our Product Development & Marketing Manager across merchandise marketing, product launches, social media, creator outreach, and day-to-day marketing execution.

You’ll be working on some of Telos Media’s biggest and most exciting brands, includingSolarBalls, MrSpherical, RunMonsterRun, and other upcoming projects.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes getting things done. The Marketing Manager owns the strategy and direction. You’ll help turn those plans into real campaigns, content, partnerships, launches, and sales.

You should genuinely understand and enjoy the worlds we’re building. Our products are made for fans, collectors, and online communities, so you need to understand why people love these shows and what makes our audience excited to buy, collect, share, and talk about them.

What You'll Do

Marketing & Campaigns

  • Help execute the marketing calendar and keep campaigns moving.
  • Support merchandise launches from planning through to launch day.
  • Help create and organise marketing assets including social posts, graphics, videos, product images, emails, and promotional materials in collaboration with our artists & designs.
  • Support promotions, product announcements, seasonal campaigns, and other marketing initiatives.
  • Come up with and help produce fun, engaging skits and other content that naturally features our products and brands.
  • Help execute social media and Shorts marketing alongside the Community Team.
  • Support email marketing and other customer-facing campaigns.
  • Research trends, competitors, products, creators, and marketing opportunities.
  • Help turn product ideas and campaign ideas into actual marketing executions.

Creator & Partner Outreach

  • Find and develop opportunities for UGC, product features, reviews, unboxings, integrations, and other creator-led content.
  • Identify YouTubers, creators, influencers, communities, and other potential partners who would genuinely fit our brands and products.
  • Reach out to creators about product features, reviews, gifting, collaborations, and other promotional opportunities.
  • Build and maintain creator outreach lists.
  • Follow up consistently and keep opportunities moving. Make sure creators receive the right products, information, talking points, and assets.
  • Help brief creators and provide creative direction where needed, while allowing their content to feel natural to their audience..
  • Track outreach, responses, opportunities, and results.
  • Find new ways to get Telos products in front of relevant audiences.

E-commerce & Product Support

  • Support merchandise launches and updates across our online stores.
  • Check product pages, product information, images, links, and promotional content before they go live.
  • Help research what fans and customers want by looking at customer feedback, competitor products, trends, and community conversations.
  • Help gather audience insights that can inform future products and campaigns.
  • Support product development by researching ideas, references, trends, and opportunities.
  • Work with the E-commerce Manager, artists, editors, web developer, production teams, and other teams to get things launched.

General Marketing Execution

  • Keep marketing files, assets, links, and information organised.
  • Coordinate with different teams and follow up on tasks to make sure things get done.
  • Spot mistakes, missing information, or things that could be improved before they become problems.
  • Take ownership of smaller marketing projects from start to finish.
  • Help with research, reporting, and basic marketing analysis.
  • Take on other marketing projects where an extra pair of hands can make a meaningful difference.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 1–3+ years of experience in marketing, e-commerce, social media, content marketing, or a similar role.
  • Experience working on real marketing campaigns, products, or e-commerce businesses.
  • Experience with e-commerce, ideally involving physical products, merchandise, product launches, or online stores.
  • Experience with social media and content, particularly YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with creator, influencer, community, or partnership outreach.
  • Strong written English and the ability to write clear, natural marketing and outreach copy.
  • Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple moving pieces.
  • Comfortable using tools such as Google Workspace, Meta Business Suite, Canva, AI tools, social platforms, and other marketing tools.
  • Able to learn quickly and work independently without needing constant direction.
  • A portfolio or examples of previous marketing, social media, content, campaign, or creative work.

You Should Also Be A Fan

This is important.

You don't need to be a lifelong SolarBalls expert, but you should genuinely like and understand the kinds of products and communities we're building for.

We're particularly interested in people who:

  • Know or are genuinely interested in SolarBalls, MrSpherical, RunMonsterRun, YouTube animation, creator-led entertainment, or similar online communities.
  • Enjoy collecting things such as cards, figures, merchandise, trading cards, or other fandom products.
  • Understand why people become fans of a show and want to own something connected to it.
  • Spend time on YouTube and understand creator communities and online fandoms.
  • Are curious about what fans are talking about, sharing, buying, and getting excited about.
  • Can look at a product and think “Would a fan actually want this?”
  • Understand that marketing to a passionate audience is different from marketing a generic consumer product.

Being a collector or genuinely passionate fan is a big plus.

We'd Also Love If You Have

  • Experience with creator or influencer marketing.
  • Experience with Shopify or another e-commerce platform.
  • Experience with email marketing tools.
  • Experience with basic analytics and reporting.
  • Experience working with merchandise, consumer products, collectibles, or creator-led brands.
  • Basic graphic design or video editing skills.
  • Experience running or supporting product launches.
  • Strong familiarity with YouTube and online creator communities.

How You Work

You are proactive, curious, and resourceful.

You don't wait for someone to give you a step-by-step list for everything. If you see something that needs doing, you figure out the next step and get it moving.

You are comfortable asking:

“I noticed this. Should I take care of it?”

You follow through. You chase things when needed. You notice details. And when something isn't working, you flag it instead of letting it sit.

Most importantly, you care about the end result, not just completing tasks.

What Good Looks Like

You make the Marketing Manager faster and more effective.

Campaigns keep moving. Launches are properly supported. Creator outreach happens consistently. Marketing assets are ready. Social content gets published. Product pages are checked. Opportunities don't get forgotten.

You also bring fan perspective to the work. You understand the audience well enough to spot ideas that could genuinely excite them.

The Goal

Help Telos Media turn the audiences behind our brands into engaged fans and customers.

Create more excitement around our products, get them in front of the right people, support great launches, and help build merchandise that fans genuinely want to own.

POSITION PURPOSE

The HRIS Manager is responsible for the administration, configuration, maintenance, and optimization of YPO's Human Resources Information System (HRIS). This role serves as the organization's functional expert for the HRIS platform, ensuring system reliability, data integrity, security, and effective support of HR business processes.

Working closely with Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, IT, Talent Acquisition, and other stakeholders, the HRIS Manager administers HRIS, manages system updates and enhancements, develops reporting and analytics, and provides expert guidance to support business operations and an efficient user experience.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

HRIS Administration & Configuration

  • Administer, configure, and maintain the HRIS platform, ensuring system performance, reliability, security, and data integrity.
  • Serve as the primary functional subject matter expert (SME) for HRIS, providing guidance and support to HR and business stakeholders.
  • Configure and maintain HRIS business processes, organizational structures, security roles, and system settings to support HR operations.
  • Plan, test, and implement HRIS releases, configuration changes, and approved system enhancements.

Data, Reporting & Compliance

  • Develop, maintain, and distribute reports, dashboards, and analytics that support operational, compliance, and business decision-making.
  • Maintain data governance through regular audits, data validation, security administration, and documentation to ensure system accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance.
  • Develop and maintain HRIS documentation, including system configurations, business processes, and standard operating procedures to support consistency and business continuity.

Stakeholder & Vendor Partnership

  • Partner with Human Resources, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, Finance, IT, and other stakeholders to gather business requirements, troubleshoot issues, and implement system enhancements.
  • Manage relationships with HRIS vendors and service providers, coordinating issue resolution, system enhancements, contract renewals, and ensuring invoices are reviewed, submitted, and processed in accordance with organizational policies.
  • Provide end-user support and training, developing resources that promote effective use of HRIS and a positive user experience.

Projects & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead and manage HRIS-related projects from planning through implementation, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, timelines, dependencies, risks, and deliverables to ensure successful execution and alignment with business needs.
  • Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve HR processes through effective use of HRIS functionality and system capabilities.

SKILLS

  • Highly collaborative and consultative approach, with the ability to build effective working relationships across HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, vendors, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong ability to understand business needs and translate business requirements into clear functional system requirements, configurations, and solutions.
  • Ability to facilitate conversations with stakeholders, ask effective questions, clarify requirements, and build alignment on system needs, priorities, and solutions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate processes, identify root causes, and recommend practical system solutions.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, including the ability to coordinate stakeholders, priorities, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts, system impacts, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy, system integrity, and quality.
  • Ability to work independently while proactively engaging stakeholders and communicating progress, risks, dependencies, and decisions.
  • Demonstrated customer-service mindset with the ability to provide responsive, solutions-oriented support to system users.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and maintain the confidentiality and integrity of sensitive information.
  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a global, multicultural environment with changing priorities and business needs.

EXPERIENCE/BACKGROUND

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of HRIS experience, including administration and support.
  • Experience configuring and maintaining business processes, security, reporting, and core HCM functionality.
  • Experience developing reports, dashboards, and HR analytics.
  • Experience supporting releases, testing, and system enhancements.
  • Strong understanding of HR processes and data governance principles.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects and priorities effectively in a collaborative environment.

Preferred:

  • Experience with integrations
  • Experience supporting a global workforce.
  • Experience working with Agile or other project management methodologies
  • Familiarity with process management principles such as Six Sigma

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to work flexible and/or extended hours as needed to support associates across multiple time zones.
  • Ability to work for extended periods at a computer.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed (approximately 5%)

COMPENSATION & PAY TRANSPARENCY

Compensation at YPO is one part of a broader Total Rewards philosophy built to attract, motivate, and retain talented people in every country and function where we operate. We aim to be fair, consistent, and thoughtful stewards of our resources, and we ground pay decisions in market data, role scope, and internal equity rather than negotiation alone.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description A bit about this role: Devoted Medical has built a best-in-class Hypertension Clinic to manage and coordinate care in a manner consistent with Devoted’s values of treating every member like family.
jobs.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

Devoted Medical has built a best-in-class Hypertension Clinic to manage and coordinate care in a manner consistent with Devoted’s values of treating every member like family. Members with chronic conditions, like hypertension, often lack access to high-quality care because of a scarcity of primary or specialist care in their community or personal barriers to traveling to seek care. Elevated blood pressure is the leading contributor of cardiovascular morbidity and mortality– in fact, complications from raised blood pressure account for 53% of all heart disease and stroke deaths globally. Despite a mountain of proven effective interventions, the prevalence of hypertension and adverse events related to cardiovascular disease are rising at an alarming rate.

We are on a mission to eradicate preventable death due to hypertension by replicating best-in-class hypertension care through our virtual care platform. Our multidisciplinary team combines remote monitoring, medication management, and high-touch disease education to deliver seamless speciality care in the comfort of our members’ homes.

As a Cardiovascular Clinical Guide, you will make a meaningful impact every day by supporting members throughout their care journey. Drawing on your coaching skills, you’ll review each member’s medical history, medications, and lifestyle habits, and help them build the confidence and tools they need to monitor and improve their cardiovascular health. You’ll play a key role on our specialty care team, empowering members to set achievable goals, overcome barriers, and make lasting changes that lead to healthier, more fulfilling lives.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Screen members for eligibility in the Hypertension Clinic

  • Provision BP monitors, assess proper measurement technique, and reinforce accurate self-monitoring practices

  • Conduct comprehensive hypertension assessments, including review of medical history, medications, adherence patterns, and lifestyle habits

  • Deliver intensive lifestyle and nutrition counseling focused on sodium and alcohol reduction, weight management through heart-healthy eating and portion control, increased physical activity, and smoking cessation support

  • Identify barriers to healthy behaviors and coach members toward realistic, sustainable health goals

  • Utilize motivational interviewing skills with the goal to influence positive sustained behavioral changes

  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation of all member interactions

  • Schedule follow-up appointments with yourself, program providers, or the member’s primary care provider as needed

  • Connect members with the right resources within Devoted to troubleshoot clinical or care-coordination issues

  • Coordinate multidisciplinary care with Devoted teams, including Specialty Care NPs, Clinical Pharmacists, Social Workers, Behavioral Health, Community Guides (financial assistance), Clinical Associates, and Outbound Guides

  • Serve as the member’s primary point of contact throughout program enrollment, guiding them through the care journey

  • Synchronize and communicate care plans with PCP or other community care providers

  • Conduct outreach calls to members as needed

  • Identify and close applicable Stars measure gaps during member visits to support quality and performance goals

Attributes to success

  • Great communication skills — you have the desire and ability to listen and engage with our members in a virtual setting

  • Basic understanding of hypertension (high blood pressure) and/or cardiovascular disease

  • Ability to counsel members on therapeutic lifestyle modifications

  • Influential with the ability to motivate and empower people to change

  • Comfort with multi-tasking (e.g., talking to member while simultaneously typing notes)

  • Great organization and prioritization skills

  • Independent and natural problem solver

  • Experience working as part of a multidisciplinary care team

  • Customer service is built into the very fibers of your being and you are passionate about helping others

  • Self-reflective and have a can-do attitude

  • You welcome change with embracing arms

Desired skills and experience:

  • Certified health coach required

  • At least 2 years of work experience in longitudinal chronic disease management (e.g., primary care, specialty care, etc.)

  • Spanish bilingual is highly desired

  • Experience caring for Medicare patients

Pay range: $27-$32/hour

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Healthcare equality is at the center of Devoted’s mission to treat our members like family. We are committed to a diverse and vibrant workforce.

At Devoted Health, we’re on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for every person like family. That’s why we’re gathering smart, diverse, and big-hearted people to create a new kind of all-in-one healthcare company — one that combines compassion, health insurance, clinical care, service, and technology-to deliver a complete and integrated healthcare solution that delivers high quality care that everyone would want for someone they love.   • Be actively mentoring or raising the engineering bar through code reviews and architecture input
  • Have a documented example of measurable productivity gains from AI adoption in your own workflow

WHAT YOU'VE ACCOMPLISHED

  • Experience working effectively with both technical and business stakeholders

  • A demonstrated AI-first mindset — AI-powered development workflows, automation of repetitive engineering tasks, use of AI for debugging/testing/architecture exploration/documentation, and evidence of measurable productivity gains through AI adoption
  • Bonus: experience building AI-native data products, semantic layers, RAG systems, vector databases, knowledge graphs, or enabling AI agents to consume operational business data

The Process Server Performance Proof Team sits at the intersection of support and compliance, ensuring that proofs of service submitted by field servers are accurate, legally sufficient, and returned in a timely manner. This team acts as the front line for reviewing proof documentation, coaching servers on correct completion, and resolving problem documents before they become case-jeopardizing errors. This is not a document-processing or e-filing role it's a performance and compliance-driven function focused on getting proofs right and getting servers the feedback they need to improve.

This position is remote but located in Montana, North Dakota, Kansas, Oklahoma, Iowa, Arkansas, Michigan, Wisconsin, Indiana, Kentucky, North Carolina, South Carolina, Virginia, Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama, Florida.

Proof Review & Compliance

Server Coaching & Escalation Handling

Collaboration

  • Clear, constructive communication skills — this role involves ongoing coaching and feedback with field servers

  • A support-and-compliance mindset: equal parts helping servers succeed and holding the line on accuracy standards
  • Ability to manage competing priorities across daily reports, outreach, escalations, and project work

jobs.excerpt: Who we are About StripeStripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe’s Financial Crimes Compliance Risk Oversight (FinCRO) team is looking for a U.S. Regulatory Compliance Lead for our Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) business. You’ll own second-line oversight of Stripe’s U.S. BaaS products and bank-fintech partnerships. The work is practical and cross-functional: turn federal and state requirements and supervisory expectations into clear policies, controls, monitoring, evidence, and ownership.

What you’ll do

This role is focused on U.S. BaaS regulation. You’ll work across sponsor-bank and fintech responsibility mapping; BSA/AML and sanctions; consumer protection and fair lending; deposits and FDIC insurance representations; privacy, cybersecurity, incident response, and third-party risk; complaints and disputes; payment network and ACH rules; state money transmission and lending requirements; and regulatory exams, remediation, and change management.

Responsibilities

  • Own the second-line compliance framework for Stripe’s U.S. BaaS products (i.e., Capital, Issuing, and Treasury) and bank-fintech partnerships. Make sure responsibilities are clear across Stripe, sponsor banks, program managers, processors, and other partners.
  • Turn U.S. federal and state laws, guidance, enforcement actions, and supervisory expectations into practical policies, product requirements, controls, procedures, evidence standards, and monitoring.
  • Set and oversee controls for BSA/AML, customer identification and verification, customer due diligence and beneficial ownership, transaction monitoring, suspicious activity escalation, sanctions screening, and recordkeeping.
  • Oversee consumer and lending compliance for BaaS products, including UDAAP; Regulations E, Z, B, and DD; fair lending; FCRA; SCRA; FDCPA; complaints and disputes; adverse action; collections; marketing and disclosures; fees; account restrictions; and account closures.
  • Oversee deposit-product compliance, including FDIC insurance representations, Reg CC, pass-through insurance requirements, pooled or custodial structures, customer-level records, ledger integrity, reconciliation, and access to funds.
  • Define compliance expectations for privacy, cybersecurity, incident escalation, operational resilience, business continuity, data access, record retention, and an orderly wind-down of BaaS programs.
  • Provide second-line oversight on behalf of sponsor banks and other BaaS partners through risk assessments, due diligence, contract requirements, control testing, performance and complaint monitoring, issue management, and exit planning.
  • Review new U.S. BaaS products and material changes. Identify applicable obligations, control gaps, licensing implications, and launch conditions, then drive remediation to closure with clear owners.
  • Keep pace with U.S. BaaS regulatory developments and enforcement trends, assess what they mean for Stripe, and coordinate timely changes with first-line teams.
  • Help Stripe prepare for and respond to U.S. regulatory exams, supervisory engagements, audits, and formal commitments. Maintain defensible obligation mappings and evidence, identify gaps, and oversee remediation.
  • Work closely with Product, Legal, Risk, Engineering, Operations, Internal Audit, sponsor-bank teams, and other specialists. Clarify ownership, challenge control design and execution, and give leaders a clear view of risk and progress.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply.

Minimum requirements

  • At least 7 years of experience in U.S. banking, fintech, or financial-services compliance, including substantial work with BaaS, bank-fintech partnerships, embedded finance, or deposit, card, payment, or lending products.
  • A deep understanding of the U.S. regulatory framework for BaaS and how responsibilities are divided among sponsor banks, fintechs, program managers, processors, and other service providers.
  • Hands-on expertise across several relevant areas, such as BSA/AML and sanctions, consumer financial protection, fair lending, deposit and FDIC insurance requirements, third-party risk, complaints and disputes, privacy and cybersecurity, ACH or card programs, and state money transmission or lending requirements.
  • A track record of turning complex U.S. legal and regulatory requirements into practical policies, product requirements, controls, procedures, monitoring, testing, and evidence.
  • Experience with the full compliance control lifecycle: assessing risk and obligations, designing and implementing controls, documenting decisions, testing or monitoring, managing issues, overseeing remediation, and reporting to governance forums.
  • Experience reviewing new products and material changes, as well as supporting regulatory change, licensing analysis, exams, audits, enforcement remediation, or commitments to regulators and Boards.
  • Sound judgment, especially when ownership, regulatory precedent, or operating boundaries are not clear. You know how to separate second-line oversight from first-line execution and still move the work forward.
  • The ability to influence and coordinate across Compliance, Legal, Product, Engineering, Risk, Operations, Internal Audit, sponsor banks, and senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
  • Clear, concise writing and strong documentation skills. You can explain complex BaaS requirements and control decisions to technical, business, governance, partner-bank, and regulatory audiences.

The Billing / Accounts Receivable Specialist is responsible for managing assigned
accounts throughout the revenue cycle to support accurate claim submission,
timely reimbursement, and resolution of outstanding balances. This role requires
proactive follow-up with insurance payers, identification and correction of billing
issues, denial resolution, payment review, and clear documentation of all account
activity.

independently investigate unpaid or underpaid claims while knowing when to
escalate issues or request support.

  • Review assigned accounts receivable work queues, aging reports, and
outstanding claims.

electronic inquiries, and written correspondence.
  • Investigate unpaid, underpaid, rejected, and denied claims to determine the
appropriate resolution.
  • Correct billing errors and submit corrected claims, reconsiderations, and
appeals within payer filing deadlines.
  • Review remittance advice, explanation of benefits, and electronic
remittance data to verify proper claim processing.

denials, and incorrect patient responsibility.

follow-up.

timely filing.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

jobs.excerpt: Who We Are Arcadia is the AI-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Arcadia is the AI-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.

Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and cut carbon.

We deliver this through three comprehensive solutions:

  • Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
  • Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all. .
  • Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.

Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for a Director, Customer Strategy with experience in a B2B, SaaS- and product-based environment who can be a strategic thought partner to senior leaders in shaping how our customer lifecycle operating model, KPI framework, and initiatives come together – and who then helps turn that thinking into a resource, sequence, tracked reality within Customer Success & Support. We recently acquired an energy services company and we're actively upleveling and remaking what customer success looks like for a global energy management company. This role will support rebuilding the function from the outside in, starting with the customer's actual experience. We're standing up an explicit customer lifecycle operating model now: a journey-based view of the customer, from onboarding through value depth, expansion, and renewal, with real branches for at-risk recovery and parallel-track expansion — built around two distinct sales motions. We need someone who can make this function the technical, consultative, single relationship owner our customers need as they adopt an increasingly product-led set of energy management tools.

This role will report to the Senior Director of Customer Success.

Core Focus Areas

•Operating Model Execution — Building out key operating model elements from Arcadia’s customer journey/lifecycle work (i.e. cadence, templates, roles, and rhythms the customer lifecycle operating model calls for in Customer Success)

•KPI & Reporting Infrastructure — Own the CS/Support KPI framework end to end: define, build, centralize, and maintain the data & dashboards leadership relies on.

•Performance Improvement — Drive the initiatives, tooling, and quality-monitoring programs that uplevel CSM and Support performance.

•Technical Capability Building — Uplevel CSM fluency in platform and product capabilities through training and enablement.

•Change Enablement — Support the CS organization through the operational and technology change the transformation requires.

Key Responsibilities

•Operating Model Refinement & Execution — Arcadia is standing up a customer lifecycleoperating model, spanning journey stages, function ownership, cadences, and reporting design, across Customer Success, Account Management, Advisory/Delivery, and Support. You will help inform refinement of and own key pieces of the execution of that model, including: stand up the cadence and templates it calls for (e.g., QSR formats by customer archetype and segment), define coverage and tag-in protocols between functions, and keep the rollout on track as it moves from design into daily practice.

•KPI Dashboard Development, Centralized Tracking & Oversight — Own the CS/Support KPI framework end to end:

◦Build the dashboard(s): Design and stand up centralized dashboard(s) bringing together the KPIs CS and Support are measured on — retention, health score/risk signal, VOC/NPS, ticket volume and SLA performance, adoption — into one consistent view.

◦Centralize tracking: Establish a single source of truth for how each KPI is defined, calculated, and sourced, so it means the same thing to a CSM, a Support manager, and the broader business alike.

◦Maintain and provide oversight: Own the dashboard as a living tool — keeping data current, partnering with RevOps/Data/Product on data-quality issues, updating thresholds and definitions as the model matures, and retiring what no longer drives decisions.

◦Feed the reporting cadence: Make the dashboard the backbone of recurring reporting — weekly execution check-ins, the monthly portfolio review, and executive rollups — so leadership always works from one current source.

•VOC & Health-Scoring Program — Help shape the VOC and value-model strategy, then build out the operational infrastructure the VOC and value-model strategy calls for: stand up the survey instruments and loop-close process across the 5-level VOC architecture (CAB, relationship NPS, journey-stage surveys, transactional CSAT, always-on signals), and operationalize the health-scoring dashboard and thresholds that feed coverage and staffing decisions.

•Performance Improvement & Quality Monitoring — Identify and drive performance improvement initiatives that uplevel CSM and Customer Support Representative individual and departmental performance, including building out the service quality monitoring program the operating model calls for.

•Tooling & Processes Transformation — Help shape strategies for and drive implementation of the tools, technologies, and associated processes our customer journey design & operating model transformation call for (including customer ticketing & Customer-360 & AI-related tooling).

•CSM Technical Capability Building — Develop training and development protocols and tools to support CSMs becoming fluent in platform and product capabilities and solutioning.

•Change Enablement — Support adoption of new processes, tools, and solutions tied to these initiatives through training, communication, and reinforcement so change actually sticks.

Target Annual Compensation Range for this role will be $124,00 - $223,000. There will also be a competitive benefits and bonus component to the package. The exact compensation at which this job is filled will be determined by the skills, experience, and location of the qualified candidate. Please note that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position at this time.

What will help you succeed

Must Haves

  • 10+ years in customer success or customer experience leadership in B2B SaaS or B2B services
  • Experience in energy, financial services, enterprise SaaS or another complex, technical B2B services business
  • Deep knowledge of AI-enabled CS tooling — health scoring, support deflection, expansion-signal detection — and designing coverage models around it.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive immediate, measurable impact.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience designing and implementing a customer lifecycle or journey operating model — segmentation or archetypes, health scoring, RACI, relationship-owner design
  • Experience in a post-acquisition or post-merger integration, blending legacy delivery talent with platform- and product-oriented talent

Key Deliverables & Metrics (Year 1)

  • VOC & Health-Scoring Program Buildout — 5-layer VOC and health scaring model & architecture designed, with associated survey instruments, CAB design, and health-scoring dashboard established.
  • Assist Customer Support functional evolution. Established ticketing system — and associated organizational evolution of — the Customer Support function, with roles having distinct responsibilities and are organized for efficiency & quality.
  • Operating Model Buildout — Full establishment of the CS&S-owned aspects of the customer lifecycle operating model, including cadence and templates (e.g., QSR formats by customer archetype and segment), coverage and tag-in protocols between CS, AM, Support, and Advisory/Delivery, and internal operating rhythm (weekly/monthly reviews)..
  • CSM technical hiring/upskilling plan in place and executing against a defined technical-skills target
  • Retention rate for CS-owned accounts at or above company target
  • Measurable improvement in CSM-related customer satisfaction / NPS

Benefits:

  • Flexible PTO - no accrued hours and no limit on the number of vacation days exempt employees can take each year

jobs.description:
TTM Technologies, Inc. – Publicly Traded US Company, NASDAQ (TTMI) – Top-5 Global Printed Circuit Board Manufacturer

About TTM

TTM Technologies, Inc. is a leading global manufacturer of technology products, including mission systems, radio frequency (“RF”) components, RF microwave/microelectronic assemblies, and technologically advanced printed circuit boards (“PCB”s). TTM stands for time-to-market, representing how TTM's time-critical, one-stop design, engineering and manufacturing services enable customers to reduce the time required to develop new products and bring them to market.

Additional information can be found at www.ttm.com

Location:

North America. Preferences:

  • Chippewa Falls, WI
  • Eau Claire, WI
  • Syracuse, NY
  • Southern California (Santa Ana, San Diego)
  • Stafford/Stafford Springs, CT
  • Denver, CO
  • Remote – North America

Travel may be required to support talent initiatives across North America TTM sites.


POSITION SUMMARY

The Talent Management Partner Lead is a senior practitioner and people leader within TTM Technologies' Global Talent Management COE, anchored within the third arm of the TM COE dedicated to succession readiness, critical talent pool health, and organizational effectiveness.

This role works in close, day-to-day partnership with HR Business Partners (HRBPs) supporting critical and key talent — moving beyond advisory to direct execution. The Talent Management Partner Lead drives talent review cycles, succession planning, specific development programs, and targeted readiness and retention strategies from design through delivery, ensuring interventions are implemented, tracked, and producing measurable outcomes. Working alongside HRBPs, this role owns the identification, assessment, and development of critical talent within assigned client groups — translating talent data into clear, actionable insights and ensuring those insights result in real movement: successors' readiness, stronger talent pipelines, and enhanced retention of critical talent.

As a people leader, the Talent Management Partner Lead will build, develop, and manage a growing team of Talent Management Partners — setting the standard for quality talent work, coaching team members to operate with both strategic depth and executional rigor, and scaling the team's impact across the organization.

This individual operates with a high degree of autonomy while contributing to the broader goals of the Global Talent Management COE and the HR function.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


A. Strategic Talent Management

· Drive succession readiness across assigned North America client groups by building and maintaining robust successor pipelines for critical roles, ensuring depth of talent bench strength.

· Lead the identification, assessment, and development of critical talent pools — including high-potential (HiPo) employees — through structured talent reviews and calibration sessions facilitated in close partnership with HRBPs.

· Consult and partner with HRBPs on talent strategy and critical role planning within their assigned business units and sectors, serving as the dedicated talent management resource alongside the HRBP team.

· Build, monitor, and evolve succession readiness plans that align with business priorities for assigned client groups

· Assess organizational effectiveness to surface structural and capability gaps and recommend evidence-based interventions to the supporting HRBPs.

· Execute retention strategies including stay interviews, flight-risk identification, and targeted interventions for critical talent segments in partnership with HRBPs.

· Connect critical and high-potential talent to stretch assignments, mobility opportunities, and cross-functional experiences that accelerate readiness and development.

· Design and support targeted development programs in collaboration with Learning & Development and HRBPs to close identified capability gaps.

· Produce and maintain bench strength, pipeline readiness, and talent health reports; translate data into actionable insights for HR leadership and HRBP partners.

· Partner with HRBPs to ensure talent review action plan follow-through and drive accountability for critical talent outcomes within their client groups.


B. People Leadership & Team Development (M4 Managerial Responsibilities)

· Lead, coach, and develop direct reports, setting clear performance expectations and fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.

· Translate the Talent strategy and vision into team priorities, operational plans, and measurable goals with clear ownership and accountability.

· Conduct regular one-on-ones, performance reviews, and development conversations to grow team members' functional expertise and career progression.

· Hire, onboard, and integrate new team members as the function scales; establish team norms, workflows, and an effective operating cadence.

· Model inclusive leadership behaviors and champion talent practices within the team.

· Identify and remove barriers to team effectiveness; escalate critical risks and resource needs as appropriate.

· Serve as a senior thought partner to the head of global talent management, contributing to the overall strategic direction of TM COE.


C. Strategic Partnership & COE Collaboration

· Build trusted, advisory relationships with HRBP partners to integrate talent strategy into their client group planning and people decisions.

· Communicate talent health, succession risk, and pipeline readiness to HRBP partners and senior HR stakeholders through structured reporting and clear, data-driven narratives.

· Collaborate with Learning & Development, Total Rewards, and other COE partners to source and connect high-impact interventions and development solutions that close succession gaps and enhance retention of critical talent.

· Champion consistent use of talent management tools, frameworks, and processes, aligning to Global TM COE standards.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

· Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or a related field.

· 8+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 5 years in talent management, organizational development, or a closely related specialty.

· Demonstrated experience designing and facilitating talent reviews, succession planning processes, and HiPo identification and development programs.

· Proven track record of consulting with and influencing senior HR partners (HRBPs) on talent strategy, critical role planning, and workforce capability.

· Experience managing or leading HR teams, including setting goals, developing talent, and driving accountability.

· Strong analytical skills with experience translating talent data and bench strength metrics into strategic recommendations.

· Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to present complex talent insights clearly to HR leadership and HRBP audiences.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

· Master’s Degree in Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, or MBA with an HR concentration.

· Professional certification such as SHRM-SCP, SPHR, or a recognized talent management or coaching credential (e.g., SHL, Korn Ferry, DDI).

· Experience operating in a global, matrixed organization — ideally in manufacturing, technology, or defense/aerospace industries.

· Familiarity with psychometric and assessment tools used in talent identification and succession calibration.

· Experience building or scaling a talent management function or team.

· Proficiency with HRIS and talent management platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors) and data visualization tools.


COMPETENCIES / SKILLS


Competency/Proficiency Level & Description

Talent Strategy & Succession Planning

Expert – Designs and drives end-to-end succession and talent pool strategies; builds pipeline depth for critical roles.

Consulting & Partnership

Expert – Serves as a dedicated talent management advisor to HRBPs; influences talent decisions without direct authority over client groups.

Organizational Effectiveness

Advanced – Assesses org structure and capability gaps within HRBP-supported areas; surfaces and recommends interventions.

People Leadership & Coaching

Advanced – Develops, coaches, and holds direct reports accountable; models inclusive leadership.

HiPo Identification & Development

Advanced – Designs and supports targeted programs and experiences for high-potential talent in partnership with stakeholders

Retention Strategy & Risk Management

Advanced – Conducts stay interviews, identifies critical talent flight risk, and executes targeted retention interventions.

Data Analysis & Reporting

Advanced – Translates bench strength and pipeline metrics into clear, actionable insights for HR and HRBP partners.

Clear Communication

Expert – Communicates complex talent topics clearly and concisely.

Performance Excellence

Advanced – Sets high standards for self and team; monitors outcomes and drives continuous improvement.

Integrity & Confidentiality

Expert – Handles sensitive talent and organizational data with the highest level of discretion and trust.


WORK ENVIRONMENT / PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

· Standard office or remote work environment; prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer.

· Travel up to 20–25% within North America to support talent reviews, HRBP partner engagements, and team collaboration.

· Ability to work across time zones as needed to collaborate with distributed HR teams. #CORP

Management Level

Notified, votre histoire commence ici


Chez Notified, nous sommes le seul partenaire technologique exclusivement dédié aux professionnels des relations avec les investisseurs (IR) et des relations publiques (RP). Nous aidons nos clients à maîtriser et à amplifier leur communication d’entreprise. Nos plateformes intégrées de RP et d’IR simplifient chaque étape, de la diffusion des communiqués de presse, au ciblage des médias et à l’analyse des résultats, en passant par les sites Web de relations investisseurs, les publications de résultats financiers, les événements destinés aux investisseurs et les dépôts réglementaires.

Propulsés par GlobeNewswire, l’un des plus importants et des plus fiables réseaux de diffusion de communiqués de presse depuis plus de 30 ans, nous permettons aux communicateurs de contribuer à un monde mieux informé.

Notified est une société affiliée à Equiniti Group Limited (EQ), une entreprise de technologie financière qui relie l’avenir du capital, de la communication et de la gouvernance, en bâtissant la confiance sur tous les marchés qu’elle dessert.

Résumé du poste

À titre de Réviseur(se)-correcteur(trice) bilingue au sein de l’équipe mondiale de rédaction, vous relèverez d’un chef d’équipe et jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la prestation des services de diffusion de relations publiques à nos clients. Vous serez responsable de la révision et de la mise en forme des communiqués de presse de nos clients dans des délais serrés, ainsi que leur distribution à l’échelle mondiale auprès des journalistes, de plateformes d’information et de sites Web.

Ce poste exige une grande capacité de concentration, ainsi qu’un fort accent sur la révision linguistique et le service à la clientèle. Bien qu’il n’offre pas d’occasions de rédaction de contenu original, il permet de développer une expertise dans le domaine de la diffusion de communiqués de presse et de fournir des conseils à nos clients.

Les clients de GlobeNewswire vont des membres de la haute direction aux professionnels des relations publiques, et ce, dans un large éventail de secteurs d’activité. Nous servons à la fois des entreprises spécialisées en RP et en RI.

Lieu

Ce poste est principalement ouvert aux candidats résidant au Canada et peut être exercé à distance.

Nous pouvons également considérer des candidats situés aux États-Unis, où le poste pourrait être offert en télétravail selon l’emplacement du candidat.

Horaire

Lundi au vendredi, de 15 h 00 à 23 h 30 (heure de l’Est)

Rémunération

25,00 $ CA de l’heure/$25.00 USD

Votre contribution à notre croissance

  • Réviser les communiqués de presse des clients afin de détecter les erreurs grammaticales, orthographiques et les incohérences. (La vérification des faits ne fait pas partie du rôle.)
  • Mettre en forme les communiqués de presse afin qu’ils correspondent le plus possible à la version originale du client.
  • Répondre aux demandes et aux questions des clients par téléphone et par courriel.
  • Aider les clients à satisfaire leurs obligations réglementaires, notamment en ce qui concerne les dépôts sur SEDAR et EDGAR.
  • Soutenir les activités de gestion de comptes, notamment la gestion des listes de diffusion, l’ajout de nouveaux utilisateurs et comptes, ainsi que la gestion des bibliothèques multimédias.
  • Collaborer efficacement avec les membres de l’équipe et les autres départements.
  • Développer une connaissance des autres produits de Notified.
  • Servir de principal point de contact pour les clients, en répondant à leurs besoins administratifs et consultatifs, en plus des demandes liées aux services de diffusion de communiqués.
  • Possibilité d’effectuer des heures supplémentaires occasionnelles lors des périodes d’activité intense.
  • Ce poste exige une disponibilité occasionnelle pour des quarts de garde les fins de semaine et les jours fériés, ainsi que pour des quarts de surveillance à distance en dehors de votre horaire habituel de travail.

Compétences et qualifications requises

Formation

  • Baccalauréat obtenu dans un établissement reconnu en anglais, communications, journalisme, marketing ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Une expérience professionnelle équivalente dans un poste similaire pourra être considérée en remplacement des exigences de formation.

Expérience

  • 1 à 2 ans d’expérience professionnelle requis (une expérience antérieure dans le domaine des services de diffusion de nouvelles constitue un atout).
  • Expérience du service à la clientèle dans un environnement dynamique et à rythme rapide.
  • Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais exigée.

Autres compétences

  • Confiance en soi, enthousiasme et attitude positive orientée vers les solutions.
  • Excellentes aptitudes pour la gestion simultanée de plusieurs tâches.
  • Capacité à demeurer concentré(e) dans des situations stressantes.
  • Excellentes compétences en gestion du temps, en établissement des priorités et en respect des échéances.

Pourquoi vous aimerez travailler avec nous

EQ est reconnue parmi les meilleurs employeurs aux États-Unis, au Royaume-

Uni et en Inde.

Ensemble, nous offrons bien plus qu’un emploi : nous offrons un environnement propice à l’épanouissement professionnel. Grâce à une expérience concrète, des projets réels et un accès à des outils de pointe, vous disposerez de tout ce dont vous avez besoin pour bâtir une carrière enrichissante.

Vous ferez partie d’une équipe diversifiée et internationale, unie par l’innovation, la collaboration et une passion commune pour son travail. Grâce à des modalités de travail flexibles, une rémunération concurrentielle, des programmes de bien-être et une culture axée sur les personnes, nous soutenons votre réussite, tant au travail qu’à l’extérieur.

Énoncé sur l’égalité des chances

Nous sommes un employeur souscrivant au principe de l’égalité des chances et prenons nos décisions d’embauche sans égard à la race, aux croyances, à la religion, à l’origine nationale, au sexe (y compris la grossesse, l’identité de genre et l’orientation sexuelle), au statut parental, à l’état civil, à l’âge, à un handicap, aux antécédents médicaux familiaux ou à l’information génétique, à l’appartenance politique, au service militaire, au statut à l’égard de l’aide publique ou à toute autre caractéristique protégée par les lois fédérales, étatiques, provinciales ou locales applicables.

Joignez-vous à nous et grandissons ensemble.

Notified, Your Story Begins Here


We are Notified, the only technology partner dedicated to both investor relations and public relations professionals. We help our clients control and amplify the corporate narrative. Our fully integrated PR and IR platforms streamline every step from press release distribution, media targeting, and analytics to IR websites, earnings and investor events, and regulatory filings. Powered by GlobeNewswire, one of the largest and most trusted newswire distribution networks for over 30 years, we empower communicators to inform a better world.


Notified is an affiliate of Equiniti Group Limited (EQ), a fintech that connects the future of capital, communications, and governance — building trust and confidence in every market we serve.


Summary

You will review and format clients’ press releases under pressing deadlines and distribute them via their global network to journalists, terminals and websites. This position involves high concentration in editing and customer service. While this position does not offer original writing skills, there are opportunities to specialize in areas around newswire distribution and provide consultation to our clients. GlobeNewswire clients range from C-Suite executives to PR professionals, across multiple industries. We service both PR and IR companies.


Location

This position is primarily open to candidates in Canada and can be performed remotely. We may also consider candidates in the United States where the position could be remote based depending upon the candidate's location.


Shift

Monday – Friday, 3:00p - 11:30p Eastern Time


Compensation

$25.00 CAD/$25.00 USD


What Part You Will Play in Our Growth

  • Review clients’ press releases for grammatical errors, spelling errors, and inconsistencies. Does not involve fact-checking.
  • Format press releases to match the client’s original version as closely as possible.
  • Support clients with a range of requests and enquiries via phone and email.
  • Assist with our clients’ regulatory needs, such as SEDAR and EDGAR filing.
  • Assist with our clients’ account maintenance, such as managing email lists, adding new users and accounts, and managing multimedia libraries.
  • Embraces collaborating with teammates and across departments.
  • Knowledge of other Notified products.
  • Act as our clients’ primary contact, supporting our clients’ administrative and consultative needs in addition to press release service requests.
  • Ability to work occasional overtime during high volume periods.
  • Required to work occasional weekend on call shifts, holidays and occasional remote monitoring shifts outside your typical schedule each year.

Required Knowledge and Skills

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university with major course work English, Communications, Journalism, Marketing or related field required. Equivalent work experience in a similar position may be substituted for education requirements.

Experience

  • 1-2 years of professional experience required (previous newswire experience a plus).
  • Customer service experience in a fast-paced environment required.
  • Fluency in English and French required.

Other

  • Projects self-confidence, enthusiasm, and a positive, can-do attitude.
  • Excellent multi-tasking skills.
  • The ability to maintain focus in stressful situations.
  • Exceptional time-management skills, ability to prioritize assignments and meet deadlines.

Why You Will Love Working Here

EQ is recognized as a Top Employer in US, UK and India! Together we offer more than a job, we offer a place to grow. Through hands-on experience, real-world projects, and access to industry-leading tools, you’ll have what you need to build a meaningful career. You’ll join a diverse, global team united by innovation, collaboration, and a shared passion for what we do. With flexible work options, competitive pay, wellness benefits, and a people-first culture, we support your success - both at work and beyond.

jobs.description:
About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:

Upstart’s Investor Analytics team plays a pivotal role in securing capital, a critical function that powers our business. We deliver the analytical insight and technical capability behind how institutional capital partners understand and price Upstart’s credit performance, working across Capital Markets, Lending Partnerships, Machine Learning, Product, and Finance to keep that view accurate and current. Our priority right now is putting the credit groundwork in place for HELOC, Upstart’s home equity product as we go to market to raise capital,

As the Staff Analyst, Investor Analytics at Upstart, you will own the credit and performance story for our HELOC business end to end, building the performance data, automated monitoring, and recurring reporting that let us speak with authority about how the book is performing. You will partner closely with our Capital Markets, Lending Partnership, Machine Learning, and Product teams, work directly with some of the top institutional capital providers in the industry, and help model and steer deal strategy for our capital partners. We build with AI: the team uses agentic coding tools such as Claude Code and Codex daily to automate our credit pipelines, monitoring, and reporting, so more of your time goes to analysis and judgment and less to plumbing.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Partner with Capital Markets and Lending Partnerships: Engage directly with capital investors to showcase the strength of Upstart’s platform, build lasting confidence, and craft tailored capital solutions for our home equity program.
  • Own the credit performance narrative: Be the go-to voice on how the HELOC portfolio is performing — arrears and roll rates, vintage and cohort loss curves, model calibration and feature importance — and explain clearly to investors, partners, and internal leadership what is driving results and what it implies for forward risk.
  • Deliver recurring performance reporting: Produce the yield, default, and prepayment views that our capital partners and internal teams rely on, on a reliable cadence, and use them to help model and steer deal strategy.
  • Build credit intelligence infrastructure with AI: Develop the foundational financial models, data pipelines, and automated monitoring behind our credit reporting, using agentic AI tools such as Claude Code and Codex to build and maintain them so insights arrive faster and more reliably.
  • Collaborate across teams: Work hand-in-hand with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, and Finance on HELOC to shape credit metrics, craft compelling narratives, and develop financial forecasts, driving alignment on the state of the product.
  • Mentor and elevate the team: Support junior team members while fostering a culture of excellence in data, credit, and analytics, positioning the team as a hub of expertise and innovation.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Extensive Industry Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in financial services, with a focus on credit and debt - consumer or structured credit, private credit, structured products, securitization, or credit capital markets - including hands-on work with loan portfolio performance and credit risk.
  • Credit Analytics Expertise: Background in credit analytics with hands-on proficiency in Python, and SQL, and demonstrated experience analyzing and explaining portfolio credit performance, including delinquency and arrears, roll rates, vintage loss curves, and model calibration.
  • Data-Driven Decision-Making: Expertise in working with large datasets, data modeling, and building robust data pipelines, utilizing tools like Databricks, Redshift, DBT, and business intelligence tools to deliver actionable insights.
  • Quantitative Academic Foundation: Degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Data Science, or another quantitative field, providing a solid grounding in the analytical and problem-solving skills this role requires.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven Cross-Functional Collaboration: Exceptional track record of building partnerships with cross-functional teams, particularly in Finance, Product, Data Engineering, and Machine Learning, to align on strategy and drive impactful outcomes.
  • Executive-Level Storytelling: Skilled at translating complex business and performance insights into compelling, executive-ready narratives, using data visualization tools like Tableau, PowerBI, or Looker to influence strategic decisions at the C-suite level.
  • Home Equity or Mortgage Background: Familiarity with HELOC, home equity, or mortgage credit, including collateral valuation, lien position, CLTV, and property-level risk drivers. Consumer credit experience is the foundation for this role; home-secured experience is an added advantage.
  • Financial Modeling and Deal Analytics: Experience building financial models, particularly lending cash flows, book-level profitability, or valuation, and using them to support pricing, structuring, or deal strategy decisions with capital partners. Familiarity with consumer credit capital markets, private credit, or structured products is helpful here.
  • Comfort with AI-Assisted Development: Experience using agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar to build and maintain analytics pipelines, automate recurring reporting, or accelerate exploratory analysis.
  • Model Explainability and Calibration: Ability to interpret and communicate model performance, including calibration, feature importance, score-to-outcome alignment, and population drift, and to translate those findings for audiences without a modeling background.

The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S or Canada (outside of Quebec) but are expected to spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites and in-person meetings. The onsite cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

Job Description

About the Role

This role will join the FIS GTM and Sales Enablement organization as a senior member of the Field Enablement team. The Senior Field Enablement Analyst will lead the design and delivery of the solution knowledge, playbooks and on-demand learning our sales organization needs to sell with confidence. Reporting to the Director, Field Enablement, this role owns bringing GTM and product launch content to life for the field through sales playbooks, sales training, video content, e-learning and Power Learning modules delivered through our sales enablement platform (Seismic).

The successful candidate will be technology and AI savvy, using AI routinely across different platforms, such as Copilot, Claude, Jasper and Seismic, including AI-enabled role-play, to strengthen seller knowledge and performance, accelerate content creation, improve workflows and drive automation. This is a great opportunity for an experienced, collaborative and commercially minded enablement professional who enjoys processing complex product and solution content and turning it into clear, engaging learning for sales. The role suits someone who works with a high degree of autonomy across multiple platforms, influences stakeholders at all levels in a global matrix organization and constructively challenges existing processes where a simpler, smarter or more scalable approach is possible.


**Must be located in EST**


What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the creation and maintenance of solution and product sales playbooks, ensuring content is aligned to GTM messaging and launch timelines.
  • Build, publish and maintain Power Learning modules and knowledge assessments for sellers and presales via our sales enablement platform (Seismic).
  • Lead the design of AI-enabled role-play scenarios and practice content to support seller readiness ahead of client conversations.
  • Translate GTM and product launch briefs into field-ready enablement programs, partnering closely with Product Marketing and GTM stakeholders to shape launch readiness plans.

  • Manage Digital Sales Room (DSR) templates and launch communications that accompany new solution releases and connect sellers to relevant enablement content.
  • Define, track and report on enablement adoption and impact metrics, including playbook usage, knowledge assessment completion and Power Learning engagement, and turn insights into recommendations for leadership.
