  • Drive the day-to-day operating rhythm of the Field Enablement function, including status reporting to leadership, prioritization and coordination across priority initiatives.
  • Act as a trusted voice of the field, gathering seller and presales feedback to continuously improve content and delivery.
  • Work across multiple platforms and formats to review source content, extract the most relevant information and convert it into clear, engaging learning for sales.
  • Constructively challenge existing processes and recommend improvements where they can enhance the seller experience, content quality or delivery efficiency.
  • Identify and lead practical automation opportunities, test improved ways of working and simplify or scale Field Enablement processes.
  • Create and configure fit-for-purpose AI agents or reusable prompts, where appropriate, to support content processing, learning development and repeatable enablement workflows.
  • Use AI tools as part of daily work across content, learning and productivity platforms, applying sound judgement to improve quality, speed and consistency.
  • Apply a practical understanding of sales processes, frameworks, methodologies and CRM workflows when developing playbooks, learning content and seller guidance.
  • Use emerging enablement technology, including AI role-play, to provide scalable practice opportunities that strengthen seller knowledge, confidence and performance.
  • Create practical e-learning experiences that convert approved source content into structured, engaging and measurable learning for sellers and presales.
  • Design and deliver sales training sessions, both virtual and in person where required, to support solution knowledge, launch readiness and reinforcement.
  • Create short-form learning and enablement videos that make solution knowledge accessible, engaging and easy for sellers to consume on demand.
  • Produce internal deal-win success stories by gathering input from sellers and translating their experiences into clear, engaging content that shares effective approaches and lessons across the sales organization.
  • Mentor and guide more junior team members, sharing best practice and acting as a subject-matter expert on enablement tools, content standards and ways of working.

Experience and Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5–7 years of experience plus in sales enablement, marketing, or a relevant sales-facing role, with a proven track record of owning enablement initiatives end to end.
  • Learning & Development, training delivery or coaching experience is a strong plus.
  • Proven experience leading content management and content governance processes.
  • Proven ability to influence and build trusted relationships in a global matrix organization, collaborating across functions, regions and stakeholder groups, including senior leaders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex product information for a field audience.
  • Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Technology and AI savvy, with confidence using AI daily across different platforms and a willingness to learn new tools quickly.
  • Proficient in the Microsoft application suite, especially PowerPoint.
  • Positive, team-oriented attitude with strong attention to detail.
  • Continuous-improvement mindset, with the confidence to question existing approaches and suggest constructive, scalable improvements.
  • Automation mindset, with hands-on experience creating agents, reusable prompts or streamlined workflows when they add practical value.
  • Able to review, structure and simplify complex source content, then transform it into effective learning and enablement materials for sales.
  • Fast learner who can move confidently between platforms, processes and content types.
  • Solid understanding of what effective sales processes, sales frameworks and sales methodologies look like, and how enablement supports consistent seller execution
  • Working knowledge of customer relationship management (CRM) platforms, such as Salesforce, and how sellers use CRM within the sales process.
  • Able to apply learning-design principles to create effective e-learning, video and practice-based experiences for sales audiences.
  • Comfortable presenting and facilitating clear, engaging sales training for virtual or in-person audiences.
  • Video editing skills, with experience using tools such as Microsoft Clipchamp and Synthesia to create clear, engaging learning and enablement content.
  • Minimum Bachelor's degree required; a postgraduate degree is a strong plus.

Bonus Experience

  • Direct experience with Seismic or a similar sales enablement or content management platform.
  • Experience creating e-learning content, assessments or facilitating training sessions.

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

This includes configuring monitoring solutions, analyzing performance metrics, setting up alerts, and troubleshooting database issues in cloud environments.

PositionOverview

Thereason this position was created is…

As ID Plans continues to grow, expand its product portfolio, and scale its go-to-market strategy, we are creating a Director of Revenue Operations role to build the infrastructure, processes, systems, and insights that enable predictable, efficient revenue growth.

This leader will serve as the operational engine behind our Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product organizations—ensuring our revenue teams have the data, technology, processes, and analytics needed to maximize customer acquisition, retention, and expansion. You will lead strategic initiatives that improve forecasting accuracy, optimize the customer lifecycle, streamline deal execution, strengthen pipeline governance, and provide executive visibility into the health of the business.

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with operational excellence. You have experience building and scaling Revenue Operations within a SaaS or subscription-based business and understand how to align people, processes, technology, and data to drive measurable business outcomes. You enjoy solving complex business problems, identifying opportunities for automation and AI, establishing operational discipline, and translating data into actionable insights that improve performance across the revenue organization.

You will partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Finance, Product, Operations, and IT to create scalable operating rhythms, establish meaningful performance metrics, implement systems and governance that support the company's continued growth, and provide executive leadership with timely business insights. Success in this role requires strong analytical capabilities, exceptional cross-functional leadership, and a passion for building a high-performing, data-driven revenue organization.

Position Summary

Themost important ways for this person to spend their time each day is…

 Lead the Revenue Operations function by aligning Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Finance, Product, and Operations around a scalable, data-driven revenue strategy.

 Design, implement, and continuously improve the processes, systems, and workflows that support the entire customer lifecycle—from lead generation through renewal and expansion.

 Develop and maintainaccurate revenue forecasting, pipeline governance, opportunity management, and executive reporting that provide visibility into business performance and opportunities.

 Establish governance around pipeline health, opportunity progression, qualification standards, forecasting methodology, and revenue reporting.

 Partner with cross-functional leaders to optimize lead management, opportunity progression, pricing, quoting, contracting, implementation, customer handoffs, and renewal processes to improve efficiency and customer experience.

 Own the revenue technology ecosystem (CRM and supporting platforms), ensuring data integrity, user adoption, process governance, system integrations, and continuous optimization.

 Build and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and dashboards that measure pipeline health, sales productivity, customer retention, customer lifetime value, revenue growth, forecasting accuracy, and operational effectiveness.

 Identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual effort and improve scalability across the revenue organization.

 Support strategic initiatives including territory planning, capacity planning, sales compensation administration, and go-to-market execution.

 Drive operational readiness for new product launches, pricing changes, and go-to-market initiatives in partnership with Product and Marketing.

 Lead cross-functional projects that improve revenue performance, customer experience, operational efficiency, and business scalability.

 Develop executive- and board-ready reporting that provides leadership with meaningful insights into revenue performance, customer trends, and operational health.

 Establish operating rhythms, governance, and accountability across the revenue organization through regular pipeline reviews, forecasting meetings, quarterly business reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

PositionResponsibilities

Themost importanttasks and responsibilities for this role are…

A “day in the life” will consist of the following tasks and responsibilities:

Partner cross-functionally to optimize the end-to-end revenue process across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Product, and Operations.

 Own Revenue Operations systems, processes, data governance, CRM administration, and revenue technology to ensure scalability, automation, and data integrity.

 Maintain CRM standards including data quality, lifecycle management, reporting structures, workflows, integrations, and user adoption.

 Develop executive dashboards, KPI reporting, forecasting, pipeline analytics, and board-ready reporting to support strategic business decisions.

 Lead revenue operating rhythms including pipeline reviews, forecast reviews, quarterly business reviews, and performance scorecards.

 Analyze customer acquisition, retention, expansion, churn, pipeline conversion, and revenue trends to identify opportunities for business improvement.

 Identify and implement process improvements, automation, AI-enabled solutions, and operational efficiencies that increase productivity and revenue performance.

 Drive strategic initiatives including lead management, territory planning, pricing, quoting, contracting, customer lifecycle optimization, and implementation handoffs.

 Evaluate and optimize the revenue technology stack to ensure tools are fully utilized and continue to support business growth.

 Establish standardized processes, governance, and operational best practices that support scalable growth.

 Provide data-driven insights and recommendations to executive leadership to improve revenue growth, customer retention, forecasting accuracy, and operational performance.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Themost importantcharactertraits,qualifications,and experience needed to be successful in this position are…

 5+ years of progressive experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, or a related leadership role within a SaaS or subscription-based business.

 Demonstrated success building scalable revenue processes, systems, reporting, operational infrastructure, and governance that drive business growth.

 Strong analytical and financial acumen with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights and executive recommendations.

 Experience administering CRM and revenue technology platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics) while improving data quality, automation, integrations, and user adoption.

 Experience developing forecasting models, pipeline management processes, KPI dashboards, and executive reporting.

 Experience with business intelligence and reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar).

 Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Product, Operations, and IT.

 Exceptional project management, organizational, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level presentations and board-quality reporting.

 Strategic, collaborative, highly accountable, and comfortable operating as both a strategic leader and hands-on problem solver with a continuous improvement mindset.

 Advancedproficiency with Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office applications, and modern analytics and reporting tools.

Success Measures

Thesimplest, easiest way to prove this job is being done well is…

 Improve revenue growth through scalable processes, systems, governance, and operational efficiencies.

 Increase forecast accuracy and executive visibility into pipeline health and revenue performance.

 Improve pipeline discipline, opportunity conversion rates, and sales productivity.

 Improve key revenue metrics, including pipeline conversion, sales cycle length, customer retention, expansion revenue, and customer lifetime value.

 Drive CRM data integrity, user adoption, system optimization, and automation across the revenue organization.

 Successfully implement strategic Revenue Operations initiatives that improve productivity, customer experience, and operational scalability.

 Deliver meaningful KPI dashboards, executive reporting, and business insights that enable faster, data-driven decision-making.

 Establish standardized revenue operating rhythms that improve accountability and execution across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Product.

 Achieve quarterly strategic objectives and measurable business outcomes.

Cisco is one of Pellera’s largest and most strategic technology partnerships, and this is the first dedicated leadership role with have created for it. Today the relationship is managed across regions and practices without a single owner. We are hiring a senior leader to change that, and to roughly double the Cisco business over the next three years. This is a build role with an unusually strong starting position. A significant group of Cisco-oriented sellers is already hired and coming online across the next year, Cisco is investing in the partnership at record levels, and executive sponsorship sits at the EVP level. What has been missing is someone to own the plan, the relationship, and the execution end to end.

This is a national leadership role executed through influence, credibility, and a plan that regional leaders want to run. For the right person that is the appeal: national scope from day one, and a result that is visibly yours.

Relationship and Joint Planning:

  • Serve as the single senior face of Pellera to Cisco, across Cisco’s partner organization, area sales leadership, and business units.

  • Carry the growth mandate for the Cisco business across all regions and practices
  • Build and drive the target-account strategy, getting Cisco into accounts where Pellera already has the relationship and access but little or no Cisco presence
  • Partner with regional sales leadership to make Cisco a motion every account executive knows how to run, and close the participation gap across the field
  • Build the pipeline and forecast discipline that makes Cisco growth predictable rather than backend loaded.

Programs, Funding, and Enablement

  • Own capture, compliance, and reinvestment of Cisco program funding: rebates, incentives, co investment, marketing development funds, and program tiers
  • Align certifications, specializations, and partner-program milestones to where the growth is
  • Drive Cisco sales and technical enablement into every region, including onboarding and ramping newly hired Cisco-focused sellers
  • Assess field skills and coverage, and build business cases for additional capability investment

Offerings and Demand Generation

  • Develop Cisco-specific offerings, services attach, and value propositions across networking, security, collaboration, data center, and observability
  • Create and run Cisco-funded campaigns in partnership with marketing and the practices
  • Represent Pellera at Cisco and industry events, and build the reference stories that win the next deal.

What Success Looks Like in Your First Year

  • A baseline of the Cisco business by region, practice, and architecture, plus a three-year growth plan approved by Pellera leadership
  • An executed joint business plan with Cisco and a working QBR cadence • Identified partner-scorecard gaps closed, and program funding capture improved
  • Cisco enablement live in every region, with newly hired Cisco sellers ramped on schedule
  • A named target-account plan in motion, with measurable growth in the number of accounts transacting Cisco
  • Growth delivered above the partnership's recent trajectory, distributed across regions rather than concentrated in one or two

Required Skills/Abilities/Competencies:

  • Deep, current Cisco knowledge: partner program structure and tiers, incentive and rebate programs, the partner scorecard, deal registration, architectures, and how Cisco's partner investment decisions get made
  • A track record of growing a vendor practice or partner business at scale, with demonstrable revenue and margin results
  • Proven ability to lead and influence a distributed field sales organization without direct reporting authority • Business acumen. Able to build a credible growth plan, a fundable investment case, and manage to margin in a competitive, low-margin business
  • Executive presence. Credible with vendor executives, internal regional leadership, and a board-level audience.

  • Existing executive relationships within Cisco's channel organization and area leadership
  • Experience across multiple Cisco architectures, not a single product line
  • Experience working with distribution partners • Background building sales enablement programs and partner-funded demand generation
  • Experience in a private-equity-backed or high-growth integrator environment

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.

Seeking Breakthrough Makers

Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) offers countless ways to change lives. Our diverse community of more than 20,000 Breakthrough Makers will inspire you to pursue passions, develop expertise, and drive innovation.

At CHOP, your experience is valued; your voice is heard; and your contributions make a difference for patients and families. Join us as we build on our promise to advance pediatric care—and your career.


CHOP does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, national origin, religion, or any other legally protected categories in any employment, training, or vendor decisions or programs. CHOP recognizes the critical importance of a workforce rich in varied backgrounds and experiences and engages in ongoing efforts to achieve that through equally varied and non-discriminatory means.


A Brief Overview

​

Represents CHOP DCAPBS to the public as "point of first contact" to families seeking behavioral health services.Coordinates the intake and triage functions for new patients who have requested evaluation and/or care from The Department of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences at CHOP. Interviews families, evaluates presenting problems, assesses for safety and acuity, determines level of care needed, schedules initial assessments, and provides care coordination.

Works independently and in collaboration with clinicians and administrative staff within the department to ensure all aspects of the intake process are completed, including but not limited to gathering chief complaint and all pertinent medical,social, and family information, obtaining health insurance verification, and communicating with referral sources to assist in determining level of acuity and scheduling patient within most appropriate clinical program.

TiPS (Telephonic Psychiatric Consultation Service Program) is a Pennsylvania HealthChoices program designed to increase the availability of child psychiatry consultation teams, regionally and by phone, to primary care providers (PCPs) and other prescribers of psychotropic medications. The program is available for children insured by Pennsylvania’s Medical Assistance (Medicaid) Program.

What you will do

  • Answer TiPS phone line and obtain patient and consultation question information and route for appropriate services/provider
  • Be knowledgeable of local behavioral health resources and work with the care coordinator to match a specific youth/family with the most appropriate and available community resource
  • Provide Care Coordination services by working directly with patients/families to get them connected to local behavioral health services, and coordinating with Primary Care Clinicians
  • Conducts a structured, focused psychosocial intake interview with parent or guardian or prospective patient
  • Responds to contact from referring MD and/or referring agency to gather information regarding identified patient
  • Effectively assesses families’ understanding of their child’s problems and clarifies the expectations they have for evaluation and treatment services
  • Utilizes clinical knowledge and independent decision making skills to effectively identify levels of psychiatric acuity
  • Meets with designated clinician on a regular basis to determine appropriate courses of action for new high acuity patient intakes
  • Utilizes independent decision making skills to triage and refer patients to the appropriate level of care
  • Understands and accesses community resources to assist with referrals and disposition of patients, including the ability to seek insurance verification and precertification for all levels of care
  • Completes referrals to alternative levels of care, including partial and inpatient hospitalization
  • Provides referrals to prospective families whose insurance is out of network or who require more imminent services or a higher level of care than DCAPBS can provide
  • Documents when child will not be seen in Psychiatry, makes a telephone encounter and records in EPIC
  • Accurately documents all patient information and interactions with families in a timely fashion in the patient record in EPIC
  • Obtains all necessary information regarding patient’s medical/ mental health insurance and advises family how to obtain detailed information about services provided through insurance plan
  • Compiles appropriate medical, educational and/or social service reports from families regarding new patients so that information is available prior to the patient’s appointment
  • Informs family of charges and payment procedures. Facilitates communication between family and the Finance Department. Refers parents to appropriate person regarding payment plans or questions regarding insurance coverage
  • Provides confirmation of appointments to families
  • Informs family how to schedule appointments within other specialties at CHOP when such appointments are necessary
  • Fills vacancies in schedule due to cancellations to assure the most effective use of clinician’s time
  • Serves as a resource to other support staff when questions arise regarding intake information, scheduling conflicts, and difficult patient issues
  • Maintains ability to process confidential matters with high degree of diplomacy, tact and sensitivity
  • Collaborates with medical specialty providers at CHOP to facilitate scheduling chronically and acutely ill patients with co-occurring medical and mental health needs
  • Maintains working knowledge of the range of medical and behavioral health conditions encountered in pediatric patient population
  • Exhibits excellent interpersonal skills for effective communication with individuals in a variety of capacities
  • Participates in the development and monitoring of Performance Improvement activities. Makes suggestions for new ideas for process improvement
  • Collaborates with other BH intake social workers to ensure seamless care coordination
  • Attends weekly intake meeting with clinical leadership to consult on complex cases
  • Accesses clinical and administrative supervision as needed
  • Potential to provide clinical services with close supervision with the ability to advance within discipline

Education Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree - Required
  • Master's Degree Social Work or Social Sciences - Preferred

Experience Qualifications

  • At least two (2) years of related work experience - Required
  • Previous experience in complex clinical settings that required the coordination of multiple service - Required

Skills and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of normal and abnormal child development, psychiatric illness and community resources.
  • Strong knowledge of issues related to third party reimbursement.
  • Ability to interact professionally in complex and sometimes emotionally charged situations.
  • Exceptional organization and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong customer service orientation to include good listening skills
  • Strong communication skills – written and oral.
  • Excellent writing and editing skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with tact and diplomacy.
  • Excellent computer skills.
  • Ability to understand, communicate and process complicated guidelines, policies and procedures.
  • Ability to independently develop and implement processes and systems.
  • Excellent attention to detail and follow-through.

To carry out its mission, CHOP is committed to supporting the health of our patients, families, workforce, and global community. jobs.excerpt: Want to be part of a team that keeps AccuWeather's critical database environments reliable, secure, performant, and available around the clock for a global audience?
jobs.description:
Want to be part of a team that keeps AccuWeather's critical database environments reliable, secure, performant, and available around the clock for a global audience? We are looking for an experienced Database Administrator with deep hands-on expertise in SQL Server and PostgreSQL who can take ownership of the health and reliability of our production database systems while helping modernize our database infrastructure for the future. Reporting directly to the Data Architect II overseeing AccuWeather’s data architecture function, this role will serve as a hands-on database administration expert responsible for the day-to-day operational health and long-term reliability of AccuWeather's database environments. Key responsibilities include performance tuning and optimization, backup and recovery, high availability, security and access management, capacity planning, monitoring and maintenance, and incident and root-cause analysis. The DBA will work closely with the Data Architect and engineering teams to establish strong database standards, improve operational practices, and proactively address reliability and performance concerns. This role will also play an important part in the migration of select backend databases to cloud-based environments, helping assess existing workloads, plan and execute migrations, optimize databases for their target environments, and ensure appropriate performance, security, resiliency, and recoverability throughout the transition. It is an opportunity to combine deep database administration expertise with meaningful involvement in the continued modernization of AccuWeather's data infrastructure.

We are open to hiring candidates to work from our global headquarters in State College, PA, USA, or remotely.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Administer SQL Server and PostgreSQL databases end to end — performance tuning, query optimization, indexing strategy, and execution plan analysis.
  • Design, implement, and regularly test backup, replication, and disaster recovery procedures for databases, ensuring high availability across production environments.
  • Manage database security — roles, permissions, access control, and auditing.
  • Monitor and plan for database capacity — storage growth, connection pooling, and resource allocation.
  • Manage database version upgrades, patching cycles, and configuration tuning.
  • Perform routine database maintenance — index/statistics upkeep, vacuuming, storage optimization, and space reclamation — to sustain performance over time.
  • Proactively monitor database health and performance, identifying and resolving issues before they affect production.
  • Manage cloud cost optimization and capacity planning, including license reporting and true-ups, resource forecasting, and optimization of Azure compute spend through Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, and related strategies.
  • Partner with the Data Architect and engineering teams to establish database standards, improve operational practices, and proactively address reliability and performance concerns.
  • Plan and execute database migrations to the cloud, optimizing configurations for target environments, and ensuring performance, security, resiliency, and recoverability throughout the transition.
  • Build strong working relationships with engineering teams, communicating database constraints and recommendations in terms they can act on.
  • Share database expertise and best practices with less experienced administrators and engineering team members.

· Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

· Required Qualifications:

o BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, with 5+ years of experience in data operations or database administration, or MS with 3+ years of experience.

o Demonstrated experience as a database administrator with SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL, including performance tuning, backup and recovery, high availability, security and access management, and capacity planning.

o Advanced SQL/T-SQL proficiency, with working knowledge of at least one scripting language (Python or PowerShell) for database automation.

o Ability to design and implement monitoring solutions for database health, performance, and capacity.

o Experience with, or strong working knowledge of, migrating databases to cloud-based environments (e.g., Microsoft Azure).

o Awareness of the monetary costs associated with operational work.

o Demonstrated experience mentoring or coaching less experienced engineers.

· Preferred Qualifications:

o Experience with advanced replication topologies (e.g., multi-region, active-active) for SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL.

o Experience administrating, performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and performing backup/recovery of database systems (e.g. SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Azure SQL or similar systems).

o Familiarity with, or willingness to grow into, modern cloud data platforms, including Databricks and Snowflake. Experience with CI/CD automation.

o Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF) for building, orchestrating, and maintaining reliable data ingestion and loading pipelines.

o Experience participating in structured post-mortems and root cause analysis for significant incidents.

o Familiarity with data governance practices (quality checks, lineage documentation, access control).

· Skills & Competencies:

o Strong systems thinking; understands how failure in one system cascades to others across a portfolio.

o Sound judgment balancing database performance, availability, security, and cost trade-offs.

o Excellent written communication; operational health reports are usable by data consumers and leadership without interpretation.

o Sound judgment distinguishing proximate causes from systemic causes when writing postmortems.

o Mentoring and coaching skills; able to develop the operational judgment of less experienced engineers.

o Ability to lead complex incident response and drive systemic reliability improvement independently.

ABOUT ACCUWEATHER

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making.

Billions of people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™ across our consumer digital platforms. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 125 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chairman, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs.

jobs.description:
LOCATION - Canada or US or LatAm (PST coverage, can be in Atlantic, Eastern, or Central Time Zone)

We are seeking a detail-oriented Functional Consultant to support a complex Salesforce implementation with ongoing operational, functional, and change-management responsibilities. This role is deeply embedded in delivery, ensuring the platform remains stable, accurate, and aligned with evolving business needs.
Experience working with managed packages and in industries with operational complexity, such as travel, is highly advantageous.

This is a 2-month initial engagement with possible extension.

Key Responsibilities

Functional Ownership and Day-to-Day Support

  • Act as the primary functional point of contact for business users, supporting feature enhancements, configuration updates, and process refinement.
  • Analyse business requirements and translate them into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and configuration tasks.
  • Manage functional configuration such as flows, automation, page layouts, validation rules, permission sets, and declarative logic.

Change Management and Release Readiness

  • Lead functional change-management processes, ensuring new features and changes are clearly communicated, documented, and adopted.
  • Prepare impact assessments for upcoming platform or managed package upgrades.
  • Work with technical and delivery teams to plan and coordinate release cycles, including identifying risks and readiness criteria.

Testing, Quality Assurance, and Validation

  • Execute post-upgrade smoke testing to verify core functionality, booking flows, integrations, and operational processes remain stable.
  • Support full or partial regression cycles, including test planning, test case creation, defect validation, and issue tracking.
  • Validate bug fixes, ensuring functional accuracy before deployment to production.
  • Document test results, identify functional gaps, and collaborate with engineering teams to resolve issues efficiently.

Data Quality, Hygiene, and Operational Efficiency

  • Support data clean-up initiatives, including field rationalisation and process simplification.
  • Work with stakeholders to maintain consistent data standards and ensure functional processes follow best practices.

Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work closely with product owners, business SMEs, and technical architects to align functional design with broader platform strategy.
  • Facilitate workshops, gather requirements, and validate user expectations through demos, prototypes, and UAT sessions.
  • Provide clear communication and training to end users when changes are deployed.

Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor business processes and user behaviour to identify enhancement opportunities and increase efficiency.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Salesforce capabilities and managed package functionality to recommend future improvements.
  • Contribute documentation, process guides, and reusable materials to support long-term operational stability.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience as a Functional Consultant, Business Analyst, or similar role working on Salesforce delivery.
  • Strong ability to interpret business requirements and translate them into well-defined functional designs.
  • Experience performing smoke tests, regression validation, and structured test cycles.
  • Familiarity with managed packages and the functional considerations related to upgrades, dependencies, and configuration constraints.
  • Excellent organisational and communication skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Strong analytical skills with an eye for data quality, process consistency, and functional accuracy.
  • Experience in industries such as travel, hospitality, or transportation is preferred but not required.

Desirable

  • Salesforce Administrator or Consultant-level certifications.
  • Background in structured change-management approaches.
  • Familiarity with Jira or similar tooling for backlog management.
  • Experience supporting large, multi-cloud or multi-package environments.

jobs.title: Editorial Director, Global Communications
jobs.excerpt: About Us Partnership on AI is the leading forum addressing the most important and difficult decisions on the future of AI.
jobs.description:
About Us

Partnership on AI is the leading forum addressing the most important and difficult decisions on the future of AI.

We are a non-profit that invites diverse voices into the process of technical governance, design, and deployment of AI technologies.

Our essential Partners work together across industry, academia, and civil society to understand the implications of AI advancements and ensure they benefit society equitably.

Through dialogue, insight, education, and guidance, PAI informs responsible AI solutions and identifies opportunities to address humanity’s pressing challenges.

Preference for candidates based in or near: San Francisco Bay Area, Chicago, New York City, Washington, DC, Toronto, or London.

Travel: Frequent international travel required for conferences, convenings, standards meetings, and stakeholder engagement

ROLE SUMMARY

Partnership on AI (PAI) is seeking an Editorial Director, Global Communications to lead the organization's global communications function and maximize the reach, influence, and adoption of PAI's research, frameworks, recommendations, guidance, and tools.

The Editorial Director will develop and execute an integrated editorial, communications, audience engagement, and thought leadership strategy that amplifies the impact of PAI's work globally. Serving as PAI's chief editorial strategist, this role will establish editorial standards, narrative frameworks, and audience-centered communications approaches that strengthen the accessibility, relevance, and practical application of the organization's research, recommendations, frameworks, guidance, and tools. Working closely with Executive Leadership teams, Programs & Research, and Policy, the Editorial Director will oversee the full lifecycle of communications strategy from editorial planning and content development through audience segmentation, dissemination, earned media, and stakeholder engagement to ensure that PAI's insights and recommendations reach and resonate with the audiences most critical to driving awareness, influence, implementation, and adoption across international governance, standards, policy, and industry communities.

The role will serve as PAI's lead strategist, establishing editorial standards, narrative frameworks, and audience-centered communications approaches that strengthen the accessibility, relevance, and practical application of the organization's work across international governance, standards, policy, and industry communities.

This position will also lead PAI's communications team, including direct management of the Head of Digital Communications & Marketing and the Communications Lead, ensuring alignment between editorial strategy, digital engagement, audience growth, brand communications, and organizational priorities. The PAI communications team is housed within PAI’s Partnership Development department.

The ideal candidate brings exceptional editorial judgment, strategic communications expertise, audience development experience, and a demonstrated ability to translate complex technical, research, and policy topics into high-impact communications that drive engagement and action. They will be equally comfortable shaping international media relations, uplifting executive visibility, and external narrative development, driving earned media opportunities and representing PAI at international conferences and convenings.

Based in Brussels or London, the Editorial Director will serve as a key ambassador for PAI, helping expand the organization's visibility, credibility, influence, and real-world impact across the global responsible AI ecosystem.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Technical & Editorial Communications

Provide editorial oversight and strategic communications guidance for PAI frameworks, recommendations, guidance documents, reports, and technical outputs.

Ensure PAI publications are accessible, audience-centered, and positioned for practical adoption by standards organizations, auditors, policymakers, and implementation stakeholders.

Collaborate cross-functionally with Programs & Research, Policy, and Partnership teams to develop dissemination and engagement strategies for major outputs.

Develop executive briefs, speeches, keynote materials, talking points, strategic messaging documents, press materials, and external communications assets.

Support storytelling approaches that connect PAI’s technical work to broader societal, governance, and implementation challenges.

Global Communications Strategy

Lead development and execution of PAI’s international communications strategy to strengthen global visibility, influence, and adoption of PAI outputs, with a focus on building PAI’s media and communications presence outside of North America, including the EU and UK as key markets and future markets (including Asia Pacific and Africa)

Develop messaging frameworks and strategic narratives that position PAI as a leading international voice on responsible AI governance, implementation, and best practices.

Translate technical, policy, and research outputs into compelling communications tailored for policymakers, regulators, standards organizations, auditors, industry leaders, and global stakeholders.

Partner with executive leadership to shape organizational positioning, executive communications, and thought leadership strategies.

Identify emerging global policy, regulatory, and governance conversations where PAI can contribute expertise and leadership.

Provide strategic oversight of a coordinated editorial and communications calendar aligned to key global policy moments, standards initiatives, conferences, and publication launches.

Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists, editors, conference organizers, policy influencers, and international media outlets covering AI, technology policy, governance, and emerging technologies.

Drive earned media opportunities including interviews, op-eds, feature stories, speaking opportunities, podcast participation, and executive thought leadership placements.

Support executive visibility strategies for PAI leadership at major international conferences, summits, and global convenings.

Manage external PR agencies and communications partners where appropriate, including strategic planning, media coordination, and campaign execution.

Develop rapid-response communications strategies tied to emerging AI policy developments, governance debates, and major global AI announcements.

Monitor media trends and identify opportunities for PAI to contribute expert commentary and thought leadership to public discourse.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years of experience in editorial leadership, strategic communications, journalism, public affairs, or policy communications, including 5+ years leading teams.
  • Exceptional editorial judgment with experience translating complex research, governance, or technical topics into compelling narratives for diverse audiences.
  • Proven success developing communications and dissemination strategies that increase the visibility, influence, and adoption of research, frameworks, recommendations, and thought leadership.
  • Experience engaging global stakeholder audiences, including policymakers, regulators, standards organizations, industry leaders, researchers, civil society organizations, and media.
  • Strong background in earned media, executive communications, thought leadership, and relationship-building with journalists, editors, conference organizers, and other influencers.
  • Familiarity with international policy, governance, standards development, or regulatory environments; experience in AI, technology policy, digital governance, or emerging technologies preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, manage competing priorities, and use audience insights and performance metrics to strengthen communications impact.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Strategic, globally minded communicator with strong editorial instincts
  • Skilled at building relationships with international media and policy stakeholders
  • Confident representing organizations in high-profile external settings
  • Able to translate complex ideas into accessible, persuasive narratives
  • Collaborative and highly adaptable across technical and policy environments
  • Passionate about responsible AI and international governance challenges
  • Excited by international travel, convenings, and multistakeholder engagement

QUALITIES THAT ARE IMPORTANT TO US

  • Justice: Notices and addresses inequities, includes diverse perspectives, and acts fairly in decisions and collaboration.
  • Trust: Communicates openly, follows through on commitments, and demonstrates reliability and integrity.
  • Respect: Listens fully, values others' time and contributions, and collaborates thoughtfully.
  • Compassion: Shows empathy, patience, and care, especially when supporting colleagues or navigating challenges.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. What matters most is your commitment to PAI's mission and the potential you bring. We are actively interested in building a diverse pool of candidates and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Compensation

PAI's compensation philosophy reflects our commitment to fairness and equity across our distributed team. Compensation is based on role level, experience, skills, geographic location, and internal equity considerations.

Benefits

PAI offers a generous paid leave and benefits package. For US-based employees, this currently includes:

  • Twenty vacation days, three personal reflection days, and sick and family leave above industry standards
  • High-quality PPO and HMO health insurance plans, many 100% covered by PAI
  • Dental and vision insurance, 100% covered by PAI
  • Up to a 7% 401(k) match, vested immediately
  • Automatic cell phone reimbursement ($75/month)
  • Up to $1,000 annually in professional development funds
  • $150 per month for co-working space access
  • Regular team lunches and focused work days
  • Opportunities to attend AI-related conferences and to collaborate with our partners across industry, academia, and civil society

Benefits for candidates based outside the US vary by country. Please refer to our careers page for an updated list of benefits.

Location and Work Authorization

  • PAI is a remote-first organization with a global membership base and scope. This role is eligible for remote work in Brussels (Belgium), London (UK), Canada, or the United States.
  • While this role is remote, many of our colleagues, partners, and events are concentrated in the San Francisco Bay Area, Chicago, New York City, Washington, DC, Toronto, and London. Candidates based in or near one of these cities are preferred.
  • Candidates must be authorized to work in the country where they will be based. We are unable to sponsor visas at this time.

PAI is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment in all aspects of employment, including recruiting, hiring, promoting, training, professional development, social and recreational programs, compensation, benefits, transfers, discipline, and all privileges and conditions of employment. Employment decisions at PAI are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications.

PAI will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local fair chance hiring laws.

The Partnership on AI may become subject to certain governmental record keeping and reporting requirements for the administration of civil rights laws and regulations. We also track diversity in our workforce for the purpose of improving over time. In order to comply with these goals, the Partnership on AI invites employees to voluntarily self-identify their gender and race/ethnicity. Submission of this information is voluntary and refusal to provide it will not jeopardize or adversely affect employment or any consideration you may receive for employment or advancement. The information obtained will be kept confidential.

HOW TO APPLY

To apply, please submit a cover letter and resume through our application portal. Only complete applications will be reviewed.

Our hiring process typically includes an initial HR screen, one or more interviews with the hiring team, and a final conversation with senior leadership. We aim to keep candidates informed at each stage and will communicate expected timelines at the outset.

The compensation range for this role depends on where you are based:

United States: $120,000 – $165,000 USD

Canada: C165,000–C190,000 CAD

London, UK: £105,000 – £125,000 GBP

Brussels, Belgium: €120,000 – €145,000 EUR

US pay is based on three geographic zones, and the range above covers all three. Where an offer falls within the range will depend primarily on where you live, along with your experience, skills, and internal equity.

Who is Boulevard?

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.

The Customer Experience team is responsible for launching, supporting, and strengthening long-term relationships with Boulevard customers. As a Customer Success Manager, you will partner closely with our Mid-Market customers- a portfolio of sophisticated, multi-location self-care businesses- to ensure they realize meaningful, ongoing value from our platform.

In this role, you will own a book of business end-to-end, proactively managing account health, renewals, and growth opportunities. You’ll work cross-functionally, share customer insights, and help shape strategies that strengthen the customer experience and support Boulevard’s long-term growth.

Your starting cash compensation for this role is $92,000 + $23,000 OTC, depending on your current skills, experience, training, and overall market demands. This salary range is subject to change, and there is always room for growth and advancement.

Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, TechnologyAdvice helps millions of B2B technology buyers make smarter decisions by providing trusted research, practical guidance, and connections to the world's leading technology brands. Many of our leaders have grown from within, including our CEO, who started here as an intern.

We believe great work happens when people feel connected. Through company all-hands, team events, Slack communities, learning sessions, and in-person gatherings, we create intentional opportunities for our global team to collaborate, build relationships, and celebrate successes together.

All positions are open to remote work unless otherwise specified in the requirements below.

The opportunity

We are seeking an HR & Admin Coordinator based in the Philippines to support day-to-day People Operations and administrative needs across the organization. This role combines recurring HR coordination, reporting, documentation, employee follow-up, and support for onboarding, offboarding, vendors, supplies, and other administrative processes.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and comfortable handling confidential HR responsibilities while coordinating practical support across teams and locations. This person will work closely with HR leaders, managers, Payroll, Finance, IT, vendors, and onsite team members to ensure recurring processes are completed accurately and employees receive timely, consistent support.

This is a full-time role based in the Philippines.

Employment Level: Mid-Level
Employment Type: Full Time
Location: PH
Working Hours: 9PM to 6AM PHT (Apr - Oct) or 10PM to 7AM PHT (Nov - Mar)

What you'll do

  • Support recurring HR operations, including employment verifications, government and compliance requests, policy acknowledgments, employee documentation, and routine HRIS updates.
  • Maintain accurate employee records, files, and process documentation. Support audits and ensure required information is complete and up to date.
  • Prepare and maintain recurring HR reports, trackers, communications, and distribution groups, including PTO, attendance, and employee activity reporting.
  • Monitor shared HR and administrative inboxes, tickets, and requests to ensure timely follow-up, resolution, or escalation.
  • Coordinate onboarding, offboarding, and routine employee changes, including documentation, internal notifications, office access, equipment, shipping, workspace readiness, transfers, title changes, reporting-line updates, and approved compensation changes.

  • Maintain accurate HR, equipment, and office inventories; coordinate routine requests with vendors, property management, and onsite partners; and escalate facility, service, shipping, or contract-related concerns to the appropriate internal owner.
  • Provide logistical support for employee meetings and occasional company events, including materials, registration, scheduling, shipping, and expense documentation.
  • Handle confidential employee and company information with discretion and sound judgment.

Who you are

  • Proactive and solutions-oriented, with the ability to independently identify and address HR and administrative needs.
  • Comfortable working with employees, managers, senior leaders, vendors, and cross-functional partners across multiple locations and time zones.
  • Experience using Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Calendar.

jobs.excerpt: À propos de nous Nesto Cloud est la plateforme technologique hypothécaire de bout en bout, native du cloud et propulsée par l'IA au Canada.
jobs.description:
À propos de nous

Nesto Cloud est la plateforme technologique hypothécaire de bout en bout, native du cloud et propulsée par l'IA au Canada. Elle aide les institutions financières à moderniser le prêt grâce à l'automatisation intelligente par l'IA, à sa technologie propriétaire d'IA et de cloud, ainsi qu'à des solutions d'impartition des processus d'affaires (BPO).

Soutenus par l'écosystème du Groupe Nesto, nous transformons des décennies d'expertise hypothécaire en une technologie de pointe qui réduit les coûts d'exploitation hypothécaire, accélère le processus de prêt, renforce la conformité et offre des expériences exceptionnelles aux prêteurs comme aux emprunteurs.

Groupe Nesto

Le Groupe Nesto est le chef de file canadien des solutions technologiques et de financement hypothécaire, gérant plus de 80 milliards de dollars canadiens en prêts hypothécaires résidentiels et commerciaux. Privilégié par plusieurs des plus grandes institutions financières du pays, nous combinons plus de 50 ans d'expertise hypothécaire à notre technologie propriétaire cloud et d'IA pour façonner l'avenir du prêt.

Grâce à notre technologie propriétaire cloud et d'IA, nesto est devenu l'un des prêteurs hypothécaires à la croissance la plus rapide au Canada, gagnant des parts de marché dans le secteur résidentiel direct aux consommateurs (D2C), le réseau des courtiers et le secteur commercial multi-résidentiel. Reconnu parmi les entreprises du palmarès Fast 50 de Deloitte pendant trois années consécutives, nous continuons de faire évoluer l'industrie grâce à l'innovation, la technologie et des solutions axées sur le client.

Exploitant nos activités à travers notre famille de marques — CMLS, nesto et Nesto Cloud —, notre mission est de bâtir l'écosystème hypothécaire canadien du futur et de créer un véritable champion canadien des technologies de prêt et des services financiers. Pour en savoir plus :

La vie chez Nesto Cloud

Chez Nesto Cloud, vous bâtirez l'avenir du prêt aux côtés de certains des meilleurs développeurs, ingénieurs en IA et experts en prêt hypothécaire du pays. Vous travaillerez avec une pile technologique moderne et des cadres de développement propulsés par l'IA conçus pour vous aider à innover, à développer vos compétences et à accélérer votre carrière.

À propos du rôle

Depuis nos débuts, nous nous engageons à créer une plateforme technologique moderne et nativement conçue pour le nuage (cloud-native, basée sur Google Cloud) qui respecte les normes de développement et d'exploitation les plus élevées de l'industrie. Notre interface utilisateur (front-end) est développée en TypeScript avec React, et notre arrière-plan (back-end) est en Go, composé de microservices conteneurisés avec Docker, faiblement couplés, qui communiquent via des API RESTful et des files d'attente pub-sub, le tout isolé derrière différentes passerelles d'API (API gateways). Ces conteneurs sont orchestrés à l'aide de Kubernetes et surveillés par APM via Datadog. Nos pipelines CI/CD sont automatisés avec GitHub Actions, ArgoCD et notre propre outil libre (open-source) de gestion de configuration, Joy. Toute la configuration de l'infrastructure est gérée en tant que code (Infrastructure as Code) via Pulumi (similaire à Terraform, mais utilisant un langage de programmation et une API riches et extensibles, dans notre cas, TypeScript), ArgoCD et Crossplane.

Nous nous efforçons de mettre en œuvre les meilleures pratiques DevOps émergentes, telles que le GitOps, les plateformes internes pour développeurs (Internal Developer Platforms) et l'infrastructure en tant que code. Nous croyons que le DevOps va bien au-delà de la simple automatisation des pipelines ; il doit englober toutes les sphères de l'entreprise, en donnant aux acteurs et parties prenantes les moyens de contribuer activement à la réussite globale de l'organisation.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un·e développeur·se Senior Platform passionné·e qui partage nos principes fondamentaux et souhaite rejoindre notre équipe Plateforme dédiée. Cette personne doit posséder les compétences techniques et interpersonnelles nécessaires pour nous aider à faire passer notre plateforme interne pour développeurs au niveau supérieur, permettant ainsi une croissance rapide et une évolutivité durable de l'entreprise. Nous sommes ouverts à différents niveaux d'expérience et sommes fiers d'offrir une échelle de carrière transparente où votre progression au sein de l'entreprise est claire, tangible et axée sur vos aspirations.

Ce que vous ferez

Vous appliquerez les principes de l'ingénierie logicielle au développement de la plateforme, en vous concentrant sur la création d'outils, d'infrastructures et d'une expérience développeur (Developer Experience) qui permettent à chaque équipe chez nesto d'avancer rapidement et en toute confiance.

Plateforme interne pour développeurs (IDP) :

  • Façonner et bâtir notre plateforme interne pour développeurs (Internal Developer Platform - IDP), en améliorant continuellement la productivité des développeurs, l'évolutivité et la croissance durable.
  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les différents utilisateurs internes de notre chaîne de valeur afin de comprendre leurs outils et processus respectifs, dans le but de définir, développer et livrer des solutions efficaces et adaptées à leurs besoins.
  • Concevoir et faire évoluer notre IDP sous forme d'outils en ligne de commande (CLI) en Golang, de microservices et d'outils d'observabilité.
  • Contribuer à l'amélioration de l'expérience développeur chez nesto, en identifiant les lacunes et en élargissant les capacités de la plateforme pour répondre aux besoins d'une équipe d'ingénierie en pleine croissance.

Infrastructure et automatisation :

  • Créer des pratiques d'infrastructure et d'automatisation durables qui éliminent les goulots d'étranglement, réduisent les tâches répétitives (toil) et préparent la plateforme pour une croissance à long terme.
  • Améliorer l'automatisation de notre infrastructure (Golang, Pulumi, TypeScript, Crossplane) et contribuer à la maturation de notre infrastructure nuage afin de veiller à ce qu'elle soit sécurisée, conforme et rentable.
  • Maintenir et optimiser nos pipelines CI/CD (GitHub Actions) ainsi que nos processus de déploiement (Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD).
  • Corriger les problèmes de sécurité soulevés par nos outils et conseillers.

Collaboration et prise en charge de la plateforme :

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de développement pour intégrer les enjeux de plateforme et contribuer à la conception des systèmes, à la planification des capacités et aux discussions architecturales.
  • Participer au développement avec notre équipe Back-End, en apportant une perspective de plateforme aux défis techniques partagés.
  • Surveiller notre plateforme aux côtés de l'ensemble des ingénieurs, en restant ouvert·e d'esprit et à l'affût des nouvelles pratiques et technologies.
  • Partager les connaissances et les meilleures pratiques en matière d'ingénierie de plateforme, d'infrastructure et d'outils de développement avec les équipes de développement.

Profil recherché

  • 5 ans ou plus d'expérience en développement, idéalement avec Golang et TypeScript/JS.
  • 5 ans ou plus d'expérience avec les infrastructures nuage chez l'un des principaux fournisseurs (cloud providers), idéalement GCP (Google Cloud Platform).
  • Bonne maîtrise des concepts CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, de l'infrastructure en tant que code (Terraform/Pulumi) et du réseau.
  • À l'aise d'utiliser des outils d'intelligence artificielle pour stimuler votre productivité. Nous encourageons et utilisons activement l'IA dans notre travail quotidien, tout en demeurant responsables de la qualité, de la sécurité et de l'exactitude de tout ce que nous livrons, qu'il soit conçu avec l'aide de l'IA ou non.
  • Vous aimez travailler en équipe et collaborer avec des personnes aux parcours variés.
  • Vous appréciez autant la vue d'ensemble que les détails précis, et possédez une approche réfléchie et à long terme de la pensée systémique (systems thinking).
  • Passionné·e par l'apprentissage continu, vous aimez partager vos connaissances avec les autres.
  • Idéalement, vous avez des connaissances ou un intérêt pour les meilleures pratiques de sécurité (ex. : détection des vulnérabilités, détection d'intrusions).

Ce que nous offrons

  • Programme hypothécaire pour les employés : taux préférentiels exclusifs.
  • Couverture santé complète : couverture étendue de premier ordre (santé, dentaire, vision) avec couverture des médicaments à 100 %.
  • Accès à un régime d'épargne-retraite collectif REER/RPDB avec des contributions de contrepartie compétitives de l'entreprise.
  • Télémédecine et soutien familial (programmes de complément pour les congés de maternité/parentaux).
  • Lieu de travail flexible : entièrement à distance ou dans l'un de nos bureaux (Montréal, Québec, Toronto, etc.).

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Contribuez à moderniser l'industrie hypothécaire canadienne.
  • Entreprise certifiée B Corp, soulignant notre engagement social et environnemental.
  • Nous avons remporté le prix CLA du prêteur hypothécaire de l’année 2023, 2024 et 2025, qui reconnaît notre excellence en matière de services de prêt.

Diversité et Inclusion

Chez nesto, nous croyons que la créativité et la collaboration sont le résultat d'une équipe diversifiée. Nous sommes engagés à favoriser une culture de la diversité, de l'équité, de l'inclusion et de l'appartenance, et nous encourageons fortement les femmes, les personnes de couleur, les membres de la communauté LGBTQIA+ et les personnes en situation de handicap à postuler. Nous nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail inclusif et accueillant pour tous. Ce poste est ouvert à tous les candidats et candidates et peut être occupé à distance depuis n'importe où au Canada.

jobs.description:
React Native Mobile Application Developer

Start Date: November 2026

Job Type: Full-Time

Labor Category: TECH

Location: Remote

Xentity is seeking to fill a React Native Mobile Application Developer position to lead the development and continued enhancement of mobile applications supporting the wildland fire community. The developer will be responsible for designing and implementing mobile experiences used by field personnel and fire management teams, with an emphasis on reliable operation in challenging environments where connectivity may be limited or unavailable.

The position will focus primarily on React Native mobile application development while also contributing to Xentity's React-based web applications. The successful candidate will have hands-on experience developing and supporting at least one production mobile application that has been published to the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and will be able to demonstrate their specific development contributions to that application.

The developer will work extensively with React Native, offline application capabilities, local data storage, mobile mapping, and Esri ArcGIS technologies. The role requires an understanding of the complete mobile application lifecycle, including local development, testing, application configuration, signing, builds, and store submission processes. The developer will not be responsible for operating the mobile CI/CD deployment pipeline, but must have sufficient knowledge of mobile build and deployment processes to define requirements, troubleshoot issues, and effectively support the team responsible for mobile CI/CD.

Position Scope

  • Lead the design and development of React Native mobile applications supporting wildland fire operations and field personnel.
  • Develop mobile applications designed to operate reliably in remote and low-connectivity environments, including offline mapping and data capabilities.
  • Implement mobile mapping functionality using Esri ArcGIS technologies, including maps, feature layers, geographic data, and offline workflows.
  • Work closely with backend, GIS, and web application developers to integrate mobile applications with APIs, data services, and existing Xentity application platforms.
  • Provide technical guidance to the mobile CI/CD team regarding application build requirements, environment configuration, signing, provisioning, testing, and App Store/Google Play release requirements.
  • Troubleshoot mobile build, device, operating system, performance, connectivity, and application issues and work with the appropriate team members to resolve them.

About the Role

Marketing at RELEX is shifting toward a more programmatic, data-driven, and AI-powered engine. This is a role for someone who is both a hands-on architect with technical acumen and a strategic, GTM-oriented leader. You will set the operating vision for the team and stay close enough to the technical setup to own it in practice. You will lead and develop a first-class team of four with deep expertise across our marketing systems, AI enablement, modern workflow automation, lead management, data strategy, reporting, email marketing, and custom internal tool development for use cases across the marketing function.

You will help steer operational development project prioritisation across the function and partner closely with leaders and stakeholders in Marketing, Sales Operations, Business Development, IT, to ensure marketing and sales run on integrated systems, data, and measurement, from first touches through to revenue.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • MarTech stack & architecture - Own the marketing technology stack end to end. From tool selection (including build-vs-buy decisions), to implementation and integrations. Our stack is anchored on HubSpot (marketing automation) and Salesforce (CRM), with 6sense for intent and ABM, n8n for workflow automation, Snowflake for warehousing, Supermetrics for data pipelines, and Asana for project management.
  • AI & automation roadmap and enablement - Steer the AI roadmap for the marketing function and equip marketers to adopt AI and automation for recurring workflows, prioritising the highest-impact use cases.
  • GTM alignment - Work as one operations layer with Sales Operations, Business Development, and Sales. Drive further utilization of marketing data and signals to feed and steer the broader GTM engine.
  • Data governance & analytics - Own data hygiene, privacy compliance (GDPR and regional regulations), and the processes that keep marketing data trusted. Steer data architecture improvements for more robust engagement scoring, activation and attribution. Refine and improve reporting standards to enable data-driven decision-making across the function.
  • Lead lifecycle management - Own the lead management workflows from initial signals and conversion capture, through enrichment and scoring, to handover to BDRs. Partner with Sales Operations to continue refining the trackable path from MQL to SAL to pipeline and revenue.
  • Campaign and event operations – Continue building efficiency in how the operations team supports and optimizes marketing campaigns, email marketing and event management processes in tight collaboration with key stakeholders across the function.
  • Team leadership - Lead and develop the Marketing Operations team – set the vision and clear priorities, enable them to do their best work, and champion a collaborative, high-performing culture.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5–8+ years in Marketing Operations, Revenue/GTM Operations, or a related function within B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
  • A track record of close collaboration with Sales Operations, BDR, or Sales teams on lead handover, routing, scoring, GTM motions and pipeline reporting.
  • Strong experience applying AI and automation in a marketing/GTM context, and enabling others to do the same. Familiarity with n8n or equivalent automation or orchestration platforms is beneficial.
  • Hands-on experience operating a HubSpot–Salesforce integration, with a strong grasp of MarTech ecosystems and data integration across the funnel. HubSpot super admin capability is essential.
  • A proven people leader who has built, led, and developed Operations teams.
  • Experience supporting global marketing organisations and complex sales cycles.
  • Skilled in data management, integrations, and marketing analytics
  • Proven ability to bring structure, clarity, and strategic thinking to operational environments.
  • A clear, pragmatic communicator who can steer prioritisation and influence decision making across Marketing and stakeholders.

Why This Role

  • You’ll get to define the direction of Marketing Operations at a global, AI-driven enterprise software company.
  • Lead a first-class team with deep expertise to make things happen.
  • A high-impact role with strong buy-in and tooling in place to optimize and scale our operations with AI, automation and joint process development across the GTM teams.
  • Flexibility in how and where you work, and real learning and growth opportunities in a fast-growing company.

About RELEX

RELEX Solutions creates cutting-edge supply chain and retail planning software. Within our platforms, we have the power and potential to increase adaptability, efficiency, and sustainability in the consumer goods and retail value chain. Our impact is tangible; from sustainability and eliminating waste to delighting customers and delivering great tailored tech solutions, we’re curious and passionate challenge-seekers creating the future of retail today.

We’re currently a global team of 2000+ employees working from offices in the US (Atlanta), UK, Germany, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, France, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Singapore, Australia, and our headquarters in Helsinki, Finland. We work in small teams where everyone’s input is valued. We’re passionate about what we do, we like putting our skills to the test, and we make sure we have fun during the process — because life is supposed to be fun.

RELEX Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
