jobs.title: HSE Specialist
jobs.excerpt: At Veriforce, we help companies in high-risk industries keep their people, worksites, and supply chains safe and compliant.
jobs.description:
At Veriforce, we help companies in high-risk industries keep their people, worksites, and supply chains safe and compliant. As a global leader in contractor and supply chain risk management, our SaaS platform simplifies contractor onboarding, credentialing, and compliance while providing powerful analytics and insights. Beyond software, we offer expert support, training, and consulting so our clients can operate with confidence. Together, we’re making workplaces safer every day.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a forward-thinking organization that prioritizes innovation, collaboration, and impact. As an HSE Specialist, you will play a key role in helping clients develop world-class safety and risk management programs, enhancing contractor performance, and ensuring compliance across industries. You’ll have the chance to shape safety outcomes, work with diverse clients, and grow your career in an environment that values continuous improvement, data-driven decision-making, and thought leadership.
You might be the perfect fit if:
  • You’re passionate about saving lives by helping organizations across various industries enhance their safety and risk management practices.
  • You excel at translating complex Occupational Health and Safety regulations into actionable strategies that improve operational safety and reduce risk.
  • You enjoy building trusted relationships with clients, offering guidance to develop and refine their contractor risk management processes and programs.
  • You thrive on analyzing data, identifying trends, and using insights to drive innovation in safety and risk management.
  • You’re looking for an opportunity to step into a corporate role where your expertise will influence strategic safety initiatives across multiple industries and organizations.
  • You are motivated by the chance to make a measurable impact on safety outcomes, risk mitigation, and contractor performance.

What that means day-to-day:

  • Collaborate with clients to design, implement, and mature comprehensive contractor risk management programs that align with OSHA regulations, industry standards, and organizational objectives.
  • Conduct risk assessments and audits to evaluate contractor safety performance and identify opportunities to mitigate potential hazards.
  • Benchmark and trend contractor performance metrics, providing clients with actionable insights by comparing their data to industry peers.
  • Use expertise, industry knowledge, and innovative approaches to recommend leading-edge solutions for improving HSE in contractor management.
  • Analyze data to uncover trends and insights, providing clients with evidence-based recommendations to enhance safety outcomes and mitigate risk.
  • Provide expert guidance on integrating risk management practices into contractor onboarding, training, and evaluation processes.
  • Partner with clients to develop tailored action plans that address gaps in contractor compliance, safety performance, and risk management strategies.
  • Develop and deliver impactful presentations, training sessions, and written resources to support clients in implementing and maintaining effective contractor management practices.
  • Research and establish robust HSE protocols that incorporate risk management principles to enhance contractor and supplier safety.
  • Represent the organization at industry events, conferences, and workshops to foster relationships and promote leadership in contractor safety and risk management.
  • Stay informed on the latest developments in risk management, OSHA legislation, and industry trends to continually improve service offerings.

What you’ll need to be successful:

  • A minimum of 4+ years of experience in the HSE field, with demonstrated expertise in contractor risk management, compliance, and safety auditing.
  • Recognized safety certifications such as ASP, CSP, CHST, SMS or equivalent are highly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of OSHA legislation, risk management frameworks, and industry best practices.
  • Proven ability to analyze and benchmark contractor performance metrics, identify trends, and develop actionable insights for clients.
  • Proficiency in English is required; bilingual proficiency in Spanish would be desirable but not required.
  • Experience in public speaking, delivering presentations, and developing high-quality written resources.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Science, Risk Management) or equivalent work experience.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and drive projects forward.
  • Familiarity with emerging safety trends, such as AI-driven risk management tools, is an asset.
  • Prior experience with Veriforce products a plus (CPro / VeriSource / Training Suite is a huge plus, but not required.
This role requires up to 30% – 40% travel within the US to support clients, attend industry events, and collaborate with team members.

What you’ll get in return:

Here are just a few of the great reasons to join our team!
  • Work with a global team! We have colleagues and customers across North America and around the world.
  • Veriforce is a great place to work! Our leaders and team members consistently cite our culture as one of the top reasons it’s a great place to build a career.
  • Veriforce provides
    • 100% employer-paid medical and dental insurance for employees
    • Monthly contributions to Health Savings Accounts
    • A 401(k) match that is immediately fully vested
    • Outstanding time off benefits
    • Paid time off for volunteer activities
    • Remote work opportunities
Embracing AI at Veriforce
As part of our commitment to innovation and continuous improvement, we're actively embedding AI tools and ways of working across the business. We encourage all employees to explore how AI can enhance productivity, improve decision-making, streamline processes, and create value for our customers.
The effective adoption and use of AI will form part of role expectations and will be considered as part of regular objective reviews and performance conversations. We're looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and excited about leveraging technology to work smarter and drive better outcomes.
All job offers will be contingent on the successful completion of a background check.

jobs.title: Logistics Manager
jobs.excerpt: Major League Hacking (MLH) is looking for someone to join our team either remotely or in our New York City office as our Logistics Manager.
jobs.description:
Major League Hacking (MLH) is looking for someone to join our team either remotely or in our New York City office as our Logistics Manager.

Every year, MLH helps hundreds of community leaders worldwide organize events for technologists and innovators. Our full-time team provides everything these local event organizers need, from the first day of planning through to the successful conclusion of the event. As a Logistics Manager, you’ll ensure that our hackers, team, and events receive the support they need to be successful.

You'll work with and manage our global team to fulfill events across the world.

While MLH's League is all about events, this role is all about managing the supplies, backend support, and team that allow event organizers to do what they need. Put simply this is a supply chain role, not an events role.

Our ideal candidate is someone excited about building processes and working with large-scale systems, while also being able to roll up their sleeves and solve minor problems themselves.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the Logistics team. You’ll oversee the day-to-day responsibilities of the other members of the Logistics team, including providing feedback on their work and distributing tasks.

  • Project Management. Manage a wide range of projects across teams to ensure successful roll-outs of new initiatives. You’ll be able to work with stakeholders inside and outside of the company, identify tasks, set milestones, and hold others accountable.

  • Consistent Process Improvement. While we’re proud of the processes we have in place, changes happen to the way we fulfill events, and processes often need to change. You’ll be responsible for identifying, making, and documenting changes.

  • Process Creation. As a small team, we’re always trying new things and developing new initiatives. Once they come to the Logistics team, often they’ll need a process created around them. You’ll be able to develop new processes for what we do.

  • Vendor Research, Sourcing, and Hiring. We’re nothing without our vendors. They allow us to have the scale that #MLHProvides dictates. You’ll be able to find new vendors, compare services, and hire new ones, allowing us to scale further or make changes as necessary.

  • Inventory Management. MLH has inventory and assets stored around the globe; it’s of great importance that we keep track of the inventory we have on-hand and manage its use. You’ll monitor our inventory, coordinate with stakeholders to determine appropriate levels, and ensure we maintain adequate inventories.

  • Logistics Work. While you’ll manage a team, which we hope grows, you will need to be ready, willing, and able to do any of the tasks that your team does, like creating a shipping label or booking and approving travel.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary

  • Stock options

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Travel opportunities

More About Major League Hacking (MLH)

Major League Hacking (MLH) is rethinking technical education for the modern world. Now that every company is a technology company, we need faster and more effective ways to train the talent that everyone depends on. Our unique, hands-on, community-driven approach has helped more than 1,200,000 technologists worldwide launch their careers and stay up-to-date with the latest trends. If you're passionate about technology, education, and the future of work, this is the place for you!

  • We’re a team of about 15 full-time people with team members based in New York City, London, and across India.

  • Our co-founders, Swift and Jon, were recognized for their work in education by Forbes in the 2017 30 Under 30 list.

  • We partner with some of the top technology brands, including Google, GitHub, MongoDB, Meta, and Amazon, to help them reach our community and access the latest and greatest tools.

  • We have a group of world-class investors focused on technology and impacting technical education, including General Catalyst, Alexis Ohanian (Reddit), Jeff Lawson (Twilio), Rethink Education, Jobs for the Future, and Reach Capital.

  • We are a mission-driven, Public Benefit Corporation and a B Corp, dedicated to serving the world and our community responsibly.

Requirements

  • 3-5 years of experience in a similar supply chain, logistics, or project management role

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Process driven and detail oriented personality

  • Exceptional organizational ability

  • Ability to set timelines and ensure others uphold deadlines

  • Demonstrated ability to thoughtfully and critically evaluate project requirements

  • Availability to work weekends, extended hours and travel as necessary

If you’ve found yourself excited thinking about this role, even if you don’t quite meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Hacking is all about finding different solutions to problems, and showing how your experience might serve as a substitute for our requirements might be your first hack with us.

We serve a diverse community and perspectives of women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ people, and those with backgrounds typically not served by technology, which helps us serve our community more deeply. We strongly encourage applications from people with these identities or who are members of other marginalized communities.

Our team in NYC has private offices in a coworking space. You can work flexibly from our offices or at home. We are a primarily remote company, and you will be expected to work from home (which we can help you set up to work for you as necessary).

Client Insights Director

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

  • Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action.

What will you be doing?

You’ll partner with clients to align Circana’s solutions, data and analytics to their business goals, delivering actionable insights that drive measurable outcomes.

The role partners closely with clients and internal stakeholders to translate business challenges into analytical approaches, and to identify and close opportunities for ad hoc projects. In addition to managing and contributing to end-to-end insight delivery, this individual will support the team on complex analyses and help drive best practices across measurement, storytelling, and client engagement.   • Champion Client Success: Ensure client satisfaction by proactively addressing challenges, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering consistent value.
  • Support Innovation and Feedback: Provide market feedback to internal teams to help refine offerings and contribute to product development.
  • Advanced Analytic Skills: Demonstrated ability to conceive, manage, and deliver fact-based analyses, with a focus on consumer solutions, providing clients with clear, actionable insights to inform strategy.

jobs.excerpt: Who We Are: TKO Group Holdings, Inc.  (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

Job Summary

The IT Governance, Risk and Compliance Manager is responsible for executing the day-to-day responsibilities for TKO’s IT compliance program which include supporting SOX and IT General Controls, audit readiness, governance documentation, and technical data reconciliation activities. Reporting to TKO’s Senior Director of IT Governance, Risk and Compliance, this role will partner closely with Legal, IT, Security, Internal Audit, Finance, and business stakeholders to support TKO’s control environment, enterprise compliance obligations, and risk management initiatives.

This role requires both subject matter expertise and hands-on execution of compliance projects and operational tasks. The successful candidate will bring deep experience in IT compliance and controls with the ability to operate autonomously while supporting multiple business units and stakeholders within a complex environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

IT Compliance Execution

  • Support the Senior Director of IT Governance, Risk and Compliance in building the overall compliance strategy and roadmap

  • Implementation and day-to-day support of an enterprise Governance, Risk and Compliance platform to include automation of risk and control matrices, evidence collection workflows, and executive reporting & dashboards.

  • Assist in tracking and delivery of key compliance initiatives including executive status updates regarding the program’s status and health

  • Provide front line support and subject matter expertise to system leads and business partners on compliance processes such as proper control execution, industry standard documentation, and change management best practices

Governance, Risk, and Documentation Management

  • Assist in establishing, documenting, and maintaining IT compliance requirements

  • Lead process re-design efforts to identify and eliminate redundant risk management processes and/or controls

  • Understand and support the risk management objectives of other TKO risk management functions

  • Maintain current inventories of in-scope systems and applications that are required to support key regulatory requirements (e.g., ICFR), in-flight IT projects, and relevant stakeholders

  • Maintain IT compliance documentation and templates, including Risk and Control Matrices, process flows, system interface documentation, and remediation plans

  • Assist in the review and assessment of documentation prepared by system leads and control owners for quality, completeness, and alignment with compliance requirements

SOX, IT General Controls, and Audit Support

  • Provide support for internal and external audits, including SOX and IT General Controls testing

  • Support the IT Compliance leader with collecting and maintaining evidence required for audit requests and management reviews, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of required materials

  • Support identification, tracking, and remediation of control gaps, deficiencies, and related action plans

  • Support risk assessments, control reviews, and compliance evaluations processes

Technical Data Reconciliation and Compliance Operations

  • Monitor adherence with internal policies and key metrics regarding control environment activities (e.g. reconciliation activities, data analysis, data hygiene, etc.)

  • Track application system owner’s adherence to the access termination process including conducting a look back analysis for terminations that do not meet the termination policy.

  • Execute established continuous monitoring processes.

Monitoring, Reporting, and Training

  • Prepare reporting for management regarding compliance status, risks, remediation efforts, and control effectiveness

  • Document, maintain and socialize training materials related to IT compliance, data privacy, and security practices

  • Support awareness efforts for IT teams and business stakeholders to promote a culture of accountability and compliance

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years experience in IT compliance, IT audit, risk management, cybersecurity compliance, or a related governance function

  • Hands on experience developing and maintaining Risk and Control Matrices, process flows, remediation plans, system inventories, and related compliance documentation

  • Demonstrated experience supporting cross-functional stakeholders such as Legal, IT, Security, Internal Audit, Finance, and business leads

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Security, Accounting, Finance, or a related field

  • Demonstrated experience supporting SOX and IT General Controls in a complex public company environment

  • Experience supporting compliance activities in connection with mergers and acquisitions

  • Experience managing third-party assurance processes, including SOC report review and evaluation

  • Familiarity with enterprise control frameworks such as NIST and ISO 27001

  • Knowledge of SAP (S/4) a plus as this is our Enterprise Finance and Accounting ERP

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of SOX, ITGC, and general compliance frameworks

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel with a strong working knowledge of PowerQuery, SQL, or similar tools preferred

  • Understanding of access management, vendor management, change management, and audit evidence requirements

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

Certifications

Preferred certifications include:

  • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)

  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)

  • Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC)

The GDP organization builds and operates that environment, collaborating closely with game publishers and internal teams across NVIDIA to continuously evolve this environment and offer a world-class developer experience. It also interacts directly with partners to provide them guidance and support in successfully getting their content on the platform.


We're looking for a seasoned engineering leader to manage a software engineering team within NVIDIA's GeForce NOW Developer Portal (GDP) organization, supporting internal and external users. Become part of a groundbreaking team to build the services, tools, and UIs that power the GeForce NOW cloud gaming ecosystem!

  • Gain and maintain a deep understanding of how the GeForce NOW Developer Portal (GDP) organization builds and operates the various components that support NVIDIA's cloud gaming ecosystem
  • Develop, guide, and supervise a team of engineers in their daily activities.
  • Partner with multiple internal teams to develop roadmaps, development strategies and processes.
  • Gather high-level requirements and influence the design and implementation of the team's software products.
  • Present regular status updates and deep dives to various audiences, including internal stakeholders and external partners.
  • Organize, deploy and coordinate partner support activities and infrastructure.

  • BS/MS degree in Computer Science or related areas (or equivalent experience)
  • 8+ overall years of overall experience designing and building distributed software systems, including edge and networking services, with 3+ years of experience leading and developing teams of engineers with diverse technical backgrounds across organizations.
  • Experience building and operating services on AWS, including EKS, ECS Fargate, ALB/NLB, WAF, and ACM.
  • Strong ability to write code in mainstream systems programming languages such as Golang, Java, C, C++, or Rust
  • Experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration (containerd, CRI-O, Docker), and infrastructure-as-code tooling (Terraform/OpenTofu, Helm, GitOps/ArgoCD)
  • Experience with real-time, low-latency streaming systems such as WebRTC
  • Demonstrated ability to design and operate partner- and developer-facing APIs (REST/GraphQL) at scale
  • Experience with secrets management and Identity and Access Management approaches (e.g., Vault, IAM), production observability and incident response, and the ability to reach cross-functional consensus while dealing with ambiguity.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:

  • Experience in developing, maintaining and supporting a user-facing software infrastructure composed of different types of sofware components.
  • Experience in measuring and improving operational excellence
  • Experienced, persuasive, and effective presentation skills (written and verbal)
  • Demonstrated skills in leadership, communication, mentoring, analysis, problem-solving, and short/long-term planning
  • Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills and the ability to handle diverse situations.

Employment Counsel

Skillsoft is seeking an experienced Principal Employment Counsel to join our team! In this fast-paced exciting role, the Employment Counsel will work closely with the People Team and business leaders to provide timely, solutions-focused advice on a broad range of employment and employee relations matters, contributing to the overall success and growth of the company.

The successful candidate will serve as a trusted legal partner who can identify risk, exercise sound judgment, and develop practical solutions that support Skillsoft’s business objectives and values. This role offers the opportunity to advise a global organization on complex and evolving employment issues, manage international disputes and investigations, develop scalable employment practices, and collaborate across functions and regions.

This role requires a proactive and business-oriented mindset, strong analytical skills, and excellent communication and interpersonal expertise.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Employment Advice and Counsel:

  • Provide accurate and timely legal advice and counsel to internal clients on a wide range of employment corporate matters, including recruiting, hiring, onboarding and performance management.
  • Advise on sensitive and complex employee relations matters, balancing legal risk, employee experience, business objectives, and operational realities.
  • Translate complex legal requirements into clear, actionable guidance for People Team professionals, managers, and business leaders.
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and develop a deep understanding of Skillsoft’s workforce, business priorities, and operating model.

Contract Review and Negotiation:

  • Draft, review, and update employment-related documents, including, offer letters and employment agreements; restrictive covenant, confidentiality, and intellectual property agreements, separation agreements and releases; commission, bonus, and incentive plan documents; Performance management and disciplinary documentation; Investigation plans, interview outlines, findings, and remediation documents; employee policies, handbooks, notices, acknowledgments, and consent forms; workforce transition materials.
  • Review employment communications for legal risk, clarity, consistency, and alignment with company practices.
  • Develop practical templates, playbooks, checklists, and self-service resources for common employment matters.
  • Support periodic reviews of employment policies and practices to identify compliance gaps and opportunities for simplification or standardization.

Global Employment Compliance

  • Provide employment law counseling across the jurisdictions in which Skillsoft operates, coordinating with local counsel and regional stakeholders as appropriate.
  • Monitor developments in global labor and employment laws and advise on changes needed to Skillsoft policies, practices, agreements, and processes.
  • Develop and maintain tools that help Skillsoft identify, prioritize, and manage employment-related legal and compliance risk, including support regarding employee training and compliance.

Investigations and Employee Relations

  • Advise on and conduct workplace investigations involving allegations of discrimination, harassment, retaliation, misconduct, conflicts of interest, policy violations, and other sensitive employee matters.
  • Work with the People Team to define an appropriate investigation plan, privilege structure, interim measures, documentation approach, findings, remediation, and follow-up.
  • Provide clear and balanced recommendations regarding corrective action, remediation, process improvements, and retaliation monitoring.

Dispute Management

  • Manage employment litigation, administrative charges, labor proceedings, pre-litigation disputes, demand letters, and settlement negotiations in the United States and internationally.
  • Develop case strategy in partnership with internal stakeholders and external counsel, including review of factual records, assessment of exposure, preservation and discovery strategy, and evaluation of settlement options.
  • Engage and supervise counsel when as needed.

GENERAL COMPLIANCE

  • Support Skillsoft’s enterprise compliance program which includes such areas as ERM, ESG, and other regulatory compliance.
  • Strengthen compliance program infrastructure by maintaining policies, controls, and documentation that feed ERM and Audit Committee oversight, and partner with Legal Operations to reduce key-person dependency across compliance readiness.

REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8+ years of professional experience as a corporate attorney, preferably in a similar internal role or with a reputable law firm with a Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school and active membership in the bar association.
  • Strong experience and knowledge of United States employment law, with demonstrated ability to advise on global or multi-jurisdictional employment and other regulatory matters, and manage local counsel.
  • Experience advising on workplace investigations, employee relations matters, employment disputes, administrative proceedings, and employment litigation.
  • Strong drafting and review experience involving employment agreements, separation documents, policies, handbooks, investigation materials, and other employment-related documents.
  • Experience advising on and supporting corporate compliance programs, including policy governance, risk assessments, compliance training, internal controls, investigations, and regulatory compliance initiatives.
  • Familiarity with enterprise risk management (ERM), ESG-related compliance considerations, audit and compliance governance processes, and partnering with cross-functional teams to develop scalable compliance frameworks and controls.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify emerging legal and regulatory risks, develop practical compliance solutions, and implement sustainable processes that support business objectives while promoting a culture of integrity and accountability.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to provide practical advice that aligns legal risk management with business objectives.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex employment law concepts clearly and effectively to non-legal stakeholders.
  • Skilled at working collaboratively with the People Team and other cross-functional stakeholders, while also working independently, prioritizing tasks, and managing multiple matters simultaneously.
  • Ability to be agile and take initiative, recognizing opportunities and initiating actions to develop practical, scalable, and productive ways to support the business.
  • Demonstrated emotional intelligence, sound judgment, and a collaborative approach, with the ability to navigate sensitive and high-stakes issues professionally while maintaining perspective, humility, and a healthy sense of humor.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment and brings a positive, pragmatic mindset, taking the work seriously and delivering at a high level without taking themselves too seriously.

jobs.description:
🌟 Ready to help reshape a $26B industry and build the future of branded merch?

commonsku is revolutionizing the promotional products industry. Our platform empowers branded merch distributors to work smarter — managing projects, building quotes, placing orders, and collaborating with clients and suppliers seamlessly through the power of the Connected Workflow.

We’re a remote-first, community-driven team obsessed with elevating our customers, their clients, and the broader industry. Our values – Community First, Ten Steps Ahead, Fast Forward, and Delightful Work – guide us. We believe you can innovate, push forward, and do more, while also sharing a laugh, supporting your colleagues, and having a life outside of work.

We’re also proud to be officially recognized as a Certified Great Place to Work® in Canada.

If you’re energized by ambitious work, creative collaboration, and helping to build something great, you’ll want to keep reading.

🚀 About the Role: Staff Data Engineer

As our team expands, we are looking for a Staff Data Engineer to partner with our Data team! In this position, you will architect and maintain a reliable, seamless, and high-impact analytics layer that drives strategic choices across every product vertical and operational unit.

Our core data pipeline is already up and running, routing info from MySQL into Snowflake via Fivetran, transformed with dbt, and visualized inside Metabase. Now, we’re scaling up to refine our modeling standards, strengthen governance, and unlock deeper insights, giving you an immense opportunity to influence our technical roadmap. Immediate impact areas include launching our flagship distributor benchmarks and powering agentic AI query access for company-wide decision-making.

You will partner with cross-functional talent across product and engineering, champion a culture of trust and technical excellence, and directly contribute to transforming our industry for the better.

💡 About You

You’re not just looking for a job — you’re looking for a place to do your best work. You bring:

  • A community mindset — You see customers as partners and coworkers as collaborators. You lift others up, always follow through on your commitments, and thrive in a team that does the same. (Community First)

  • Momentum and ownership — You act with optimism, take initiative, and turn ideas into results. You move fast and bring others with you. (Fast Forward)

  • Vision and boldness — You don’t just react — you anticipate. You think big, challenge the status quo, and push the work (and the industry) forward. (Ten Steps Ahead)

  • Joy in the craft — You care deeply about what you build and how it makes people feel. You bring thoughtfulness, transparency, and a welcoming sense of humour to the table. (Delightful Work)

⚙️ About our Technology

Guided by our value of being Ten Steps Ahead, we are modernizing our technology to support a rapidly scaling business and user base.

Our core foundation for the Data Team is built on Snowflake. The rest of our tech stack is built on PHP, Python, React, mySQL and our infrastructure is in AWS.

Innovation remains central to our roadmap. We are pushing the boundaries of the industry by building AI features powered by OpenAI, Gemini and Anthropic APIs.

🛠️ What You’ll Do

This role balances hands-on engineering and analytics work with growing ownership, decision-making, and mentorship. Here’s what you’ll do:

  • Technical Leadership & Modeling — Guide key initiatives from inception through completion by applying robust software design principles. Transform raw transactional records into elegant star schemas that reflect our core platform domain, including orders, merch distributors, suppliers, catalog offerings, and financial workflows. (Ten Steps Ahead)

  • Data Trust & Governance — Preemptively identify and fix sluggish queries, unoptimized transformations, and testing blind spots before end-users notice. Champion overall pipeline health by overseeing automated Fivetran syncs and adapting to schema modifications seamlessly as our business scales. (Fast Forward)

  • Canonical Metrics Architecture — Establish and safeguard standardized logic within our dbt data marts, ensuring all downstream Metabase visualizations draw from a unified, trusted source of truth.

  • Empowering Self-Serve Access — Construct intuitive Snowflake and Metabase layers that enable team members to query insights independently and roll up your sleeves for complex exploratory deep dives.

  • Collaboration & Mentorship — Elevate fellow engineers and analysts through strong and goal-driven mentorship, thoughtful pull request reviews and ongoing support. Partner closely with product leads and engineering managers to translate strategic objectives into clear technical milestones, maintaining open communication around progress and challenges. (Community First)

  • AI-Powered Acceleration — Leverage modern AI coding assistants like Cursor, CodeRabbit, and Claude to boost your daily efficiency, combining automated velocity with rigorous human verification. Be the example to the team on how to use the AI tools available. (Delightful Work)

🔍 What You Bring

Some of the qualities that help you thrive in this role:

  • Professional Experience: 8+ years of experience in data engineering, or a closely related role, ideally within a SaaS or product-driven environment.

  • Technical Expertise: Strong production experience with SQL, dbt, and a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake or comparable), alongside proficiency in Python for analytics tooling and automation.

  • Data Modeling Knowledge: Deep understanding of dimensional modeling, relational databases, managed ingestion (Fivetran), and designing BI environments (Metabase) for self-serve use.

  • Mentorship Skills: A proven track record of mentoring and developing engineers or analysts, with a focus on building a healthy, collaborative, and inclusive team culture.

  • Mindset: A balance of technical excellence with pragmatic business tradeoffs, a strong sense of customer empathy, and a dedication to continuous growth and feedback.

  • AI Enthusiasm: Experience using AI-assisted development tools effectively and pushing the boundaries of how AI improves daily workflows. Experience using Snowflake AI tooling (or similar) to accelerate solutions for business needs.

💰 Compensation & Perks

We believe in fair, transparent compensation. Starting salary for this role is $160,000–$180,000, depending on previous experience and skillset. New hires are expected to come in at the midpoint of this range.

However, if this role sounds perfect for you and your expectations are outside of this range, we encourage you to apply and let us know in your application about your ideal package. If we agree that it’s a good fit, we will have open discussion around what’s possible.

Plus:

  • Remote-first culture (with plenty of excellent in-person experiences sprinkled in)

  • Company-wide closure between December 25th and January 1st

  • Health and dental benefits, including a $1,000 healthcare spending account

  • RRSP/TFSA contributions up to $3,000 a year (no employee contribution required!)

  • Twice-yearly company wide summits (we call it HQ and you’ll love it)

  • A delightful team of smart people who are good at what they do

🌎 Location

This role is open to candidates eligible to work in Canada, with the exception of Quebec (we’re not set up to operate there yet — désolé!).

We’re remote-first, but if you’re based in Toronto, even better. That’s where we were founded and where we maintain our HQ today!

🌱 A Bit More About Us

commonsku supports hundreds of promotional products distributors and suppliers with technology that drive efficiency, growth, and connection. Our skummunity (commonsku + community = skummunity, get it?) is powered by events, education, and shared knowledge and is core to who we are.

  • Можливість швидко вирости до Lead-позиції і впливати на розвиток напряму;

  • Запуск та оптимізація рекламних кампаній в Google Ads в рамках створеної стратегії та встановлених KPI;

Для цього тобі знадобиться

  • 3+ роки досвіду саме з Google Ads у рекламному агенстві або продуктовій компанії;
  • Досвід роботи з рекламним кабінетом Google Ads з конкретними результатами на Tier 1 ринках;

Твій шлях до команди Boosters

Pre-screen з рекрутером (45 хвилин) → Інтервʼю з Head of Marketing (1,5 години)→Тестове завдання → Bar-raising (1 година)

Кар’єрний та персональний розвиток

Автономію та гнучкість

  • Можливість обирати між роботою в офісі (Київ або Львів) та remote-first форматом (Україна та закордон);

Турботу про здоров’я

jobs.description:
Software Engineering Manager, GTI Team Lead

Monday – Friday 8:00 – 5:00

Remote

Corptax is the platform behind corporate tax for many of the largest enterprises in the world. Global Tax and Regulatory Intelligence (GTI) is the product that tracks tax and regulatory obligations across jurisdictions, models them as workflows, and tells our clients what is due, where, and when.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the GTI engineering team. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will run the team, own delivery, and stay close to the code. Your architecture calls and your code reviews carry real weight.

You will report to the Head of AI and work alongside product, design, and tax content on everything GTI ships.

Some of the things you will be doing:

  • The team. You will run one-on-ones, set growth plans, give direct feedback, handle performance, and hiring decisions.
  • Delivery. You will work with product to turn the roadmap into releases the team can land, and you will be accountable for the dates you agree upon.
  • Technical direction. You will make and document the architecture decisions across the frontend, the backend services, the database, and the Azure footprint.
  • Code quality. You will review pull requests, set the bar for testing, and contribute code on the novel problems we encounter daily.
  • The release process. GTI ships from a multi-service repository with release tagging, release candidates, changelog gates, and merge-back rules. You will own that process and keep it “boring” and stable.
  • Production health. You will own on-call, alert routing, and the observability stack. You will be the person who asks why an incident happened and makes sure it never happens again.
  • Hands-on work. You will definitely write code, enough of it to keep your judgment current, though it will not fill most of your week.

The Stack:

GTI has a small number of moving parts, and you should be comfortable in all of them.

  • Frontend: Next.js and TypeScript, with a shared React component library.
  • Backend: .NET and C# services behind the product APIs.
  • Data: Microsoft SQL Server, including schema design, migrations, and query tuning.
  • Hosting: Azure Container Apps, with Key Vault, Container Registry, managed identities, and private endpoints around it.
  • Delivery: GitHub Actions for CI/CD, Bicep for infrastructure, and Linear for planning.
  • Telemetry: Application Insights for tracing and PostHog for product analytics.

What technical skills, experience and qualifications do you need?

Required

  • Experience building and shipping production software, including leading a team as a manager or a technical lead.
  • Hands-on depth in C# and .NET, including API design, async work, and testing.
  • Hands-on depth in modern TypeScript and React, with Next.js experience preferred.
  • SQL Server skills: schema design, indexing, reading query plans, and running migrations against live data.
  • Production experience with containerized workloads on Azure.
  • A track record of shipping on a schedule in an Agile work environment.
  • Clear written communication. You can write a design document, an incident review, and a performance review, and all three land.

Nice to Have

  • Infrastructure as code with Bicep, and CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with observability tooling such as Application Insights, OpenTelemetry, or PostHog.
  • Experience leading a team through an agent-led development workflow with tools such as Claude Code.
  • Experience shipping LLM-backed features into production.
  • Background in tax, accounting, law, or another rule-governed domain. We can teach the domain, and it is a head start if you already have it.
  • Experience hiring and onboarding engineers.

What you get out of this:

  • A funded product with real regulatory stakes.
  • A small team you can shape, with enough room to change how it works.
  • Direct access to the Head of AI and to the AI research feeding into GTI.
  • The budget and infrastructure to do the job properly, including model APIs and Azure capacity.
  • Competitive compensation and a flexible remote setup.

Tax compliance is unforgiving. A wrong obligation date or a missed filing is a real problem for a real client, so the bar for correctness is high and the surface area keeps growing. We need someone who can hold that bar while still shipping on a schedule, and who can drive a team that holds it without being watched.

If that sounds like the kind of team you want to run, apply!

jobs.excerpt: Join AIR as the Director, Pre-Award Contracts and leverage your leadership and expertise to advance our mission.
jobs.description:
Join AIR as the Director, Pre-Award Contracts and leverage your leadership and expertise to advance our mission. This role provides strategic and operational leadership across the business development ecosystem supporting the contracting process from capture to execution of new awards from funders which will ensure compliant, efficient, and mission-aligned execution of all activities. The position reports to the Vice President, Contracts, Grants and Procurement.

The Director oversees the pre-award phase of the contracting process including identifying opportunities, execution of teaming agreements and Non Disclosure Agreements, developing business volumes for proposals and communicating with clients/funders on solicitation and award terms. This position will lead a team of specialists in supporting AIR’s Growth strategy while strengthening systems, mitigating risk, and driving continuous improvement.

This position has the flexibility to work remotely within the United States (U.S.) or from one of AIR’s U.S. office locations with occasional travel for meetings, training sessions, and conferences. This does not include U.S. territories.

About AIR:

Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, the American Institutes for Research (AIR) is a nonpartisan, not-for-profit organization that conducts behavioral and social science research and delivers technical assistance to address some of the most pressing challenges in the United States and globally. We generate evidence and apply data-driven solutions that expand opportunities and improve lives for all.

Responsibilities:

The responsibilities for the position include:

Strategic Leadership

  • Lead the development and execution of enterprise-wide strategies for pre-award contracts, aligned with organizational priorities and funding requirements.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on compliance, risk management, and optimization opportunities across all areas.

Contracts Management

  • Oversee pre-award contracting processes, including solicitation, evaluation, and negotiation of new awards across federal, state, foundation, commercial, and other funding sources.
  • Ensure effective planning and execution across a diverse portfolio of projects, funders, and vendors.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure adherence to federal, state, and sponsor regulations, including Uniform Guidance and FAR, as well as internal policies.
  • Establish and maintain risk management practices to safeguard organizational and legal interests and ensure audit readiness.

Operational Excellence

  • Drive process improvements to enhance efficiency, transparency, and service delivery across contracting functions.
  • Oversee systems, tools, and workflows to support effective tracking, reporting, and performance management.

People Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team by establishing clear goals, accountability, and professional development pathways.
  • Support career development through coaching, training, and succession planning.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and service excellence.
  • Align team structure and capabilities with organizational priorities and evolving business needs.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Post-Award Contract Administration, Procurement, Finance, Legal, HR, and program teams to ensure alignment and effective support for project execution.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, external partners, and other stakeholders within the business development ecosystem.

Reporting & Insights

  • Provide leadership with insights on key metrics, including proposal compliance, client engagement, work process efficiency, cost savings, and risk trends.
  • Support audits and reporting requirements through accurate and timely documentation.
  • Duties, responsibilities, and activities may evolve based on business priorities and external requirements.

Qualifications:

Education, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field (Master’s or JD preferred).
  • 12+ years of progressive experience across contracts, grants management, procurement, or related functions, including 5+ years in people management.
  • Deep knowledge of federal and state contracting and grants regulations (e.g., FAR, Uniform Guidance).
  • Experience supporting a wide range of funders from both public, private and commercial sectors.
  • Experience negotiating a wide range of contract types including teaming agreements, NDAs, Federal Acquisition Contracts (CPFF, T&M, FFP), Federal Assistance Agreements (Cooperative Agreements), State funded contracts, Foundation grants and international/multilateral donor agreements.

Skills

  • Analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Promote intelligent risk-taking by encouraging data-driven experimentation, challenging the status quo, and making bold decisions that strengthen operational effectiveness and business impact.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to translate complex requirements into actionable plans and measurable outcomes.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex operations in highly regulated environments.

About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:

Upstart's Verifications Decisioning Engineering team builds the backend platform that powers automated verification workflows, financial data integrations, fraud detection, and approval decisioning across our lending products. The team develops the shared services and infrastructure that enable accurate, scalable, and reusable verification capabilities, helping improve automation, accelerate funding, and maintain risk correctness and compliance across the platform.

As a Software Engineer II (L4) on the Verifications Decisioning team, you will design and build backend services that power verification workflows and financial data platforms used across multiple lending products. You'll work on distributed systems that integrate third-party financial data providers, machine learning models, and internal decisioning services while partnering closely with Product, Machine Learning, Risk, Fraud, and other engineering teams to improve automation and platform scalability.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services that power automated verification workflows, financial data integrations, and approval decisioning.
  • Develop distributed systems, APIs, and event-driven services that improve the scalability, reliability, and reuse of verification capabilities across multiple lending products.
  • Build platform capabilities that enable reusable financial data connections, streamline connection lifecycle management, and reduce operational overhead for internal engineering teams.
  • Partner with Machine Learning, Product, Risk, Fraud, and Compliance teams to integrate data, decisioning logic, and risk models into production systems while maintaining correctness and auditability.
  • Improve system reliability through comprehensive testing, monitoring, observability, and operational best practices for business-critical services.
  • Contribute to the evolution of the verification platform by improving architecture, engineering standards, and shared infrastructure that accelerates product development across Upstart.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) and 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • 3+ years of experience developing backend applications using Kotlin, Java, or another object-oriented programming language.
  • Experience designing, building, and operating distributed systems, including service-to-service APIs and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience building and maintaining scalable backend services that process business-critical or financial data in production environments.
  • Experience contributing to decision engines that integrate with machine learning models to evaluate signals..
  • Experience writing production-quality code supported by automated testing, monitoring, and observability practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of financial services, lending, fraud prevention, identity verification, or other risk-sensitive systems.
  • Experience integrating third-party financial data providers or APIs such as Plaid or similar platforms.
  • Experience building rule engines, workflow orchestration platforms, or automated decisioning systems.
  • Knowledge of how machine learning models are integrated, monitored, and evaluated within production systems.
  • Experience building reusable platform services or shared infrastructure supporting multiple engineering teams..

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are expected to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back. argenx is preparing for multi-dimensional expansion to reach more patients through a rich pipeline of differentiated assets, led by VYVGART, our first-in-class neonatal Fc receptor blocker approved for the treatment of gMG, and with the potential to treat patients across dozens of severe autoimmune diseases.

We are building a new kind of biotech company, one that maintains its roots as a science-based start-up and pushes our commitment to innovate across all corners of our business. We strive to inspire and grow our company, our partnerships, our science, and our people, because when we do, we deliver more for patients.

The Global Medical Affairs and Evidence Generation (MAEG) group delivers ambitious, patient-focused cross-regional and cross-indication medical strategies, driving data generation and dissemination, to maximize patient benefit from argenx products.


The MAEG Senior Director will provide strategic and hands-on medical leadership for empasiprubart in multifocal motor neuropathy (MMN), with a focus on medical launch readiness and evidence generation. Reporting to the empasiprubart Medical Affairs and Evidence Generation Asset Strategy Lead, the role will work in close partnership with the MMN Medical Director and regional MAEG teams, adding complementary launch expertise and capacity. The Senior Director will lead global medical workstreams from strategy through execution, acting as a co-owner across a network of teams to translate scientific and stakeholder insights into actions that accelerate patient impact.


Key accountabilities and responsibilities:

  • Lead global MMN medical launch-readiness workstreams in partnership with cross-functional and regional teams, empowering teams to co-create clear deliverables, milestones, dependencies, and measures of readiness, while proactively resolving barriers and escalating risks with proposed solutions
  • Translate prioritized MMN evidence gaps into a data-driven global evidence strategy, co-creating with the MMN Medical Director to align scientific objectives, feasibility, timelines, and resources.
  • Lead the medical strategy and scientific oversight of evidence-generation initiatives, challenging the status quo and applying innovative approaches to address complex evidence needs and improve outcomes for patients in partnership with Clinical Development, RWE, Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR), and regional MAEG teams.
  • Operate as part of a connected network of teams, co-creating with regional and country MAEG colleagues to translate global strategy into locally relevant plans, integrate regional insights, and develop shared scientific resources that enable effective local execution.
  • Build trusted partnerships with experts, healthcare and patient organizations to listen, learn, and co-create evidence, education, and insights that shape patient-centered Medical Affairs priorities.
  • Identify and prioritize MMN evidence and education needs across the patient journey, including diagnosis, treatment patterns, disease burden, functional outcomes and treatment burden, and translate these insights into actionable medical strategies.

  • Develop and continuously maintain the highest scientific and medical expertise with relevant diseases and products and be acknowledged internally and externally as an expert

  • Ensure all medical affairs activities maintain the highest standards, comply with applicable pharmaceutical regulations, as well as argenx policies and procedures 
  • Attend appropriate national and international meetings and congresses to gather intelligence, increase personal knowledge, develop relationships with customers

Education, experience and qualifications

  • Advanced degree required: M.D., Ph.D., or PharmD.
  • At least 10 years of relevant experience required in Medical Affairs, or a combination of Medical Affairs and closely related clinical development or evidence-generation roles, with substantial Medical Affairs leadership responsibility required.
  • Demonstrates entrepreneurial leadership by driving innovation, acting with co-ownership, navigating uncertainty with agility and humility, and translating diverse insights into action and meaningful patient impact.
  • Launch experience in the neuromuscular/immunology space required.
  • Experience in building empowered, high-performing networks of teams by sharing knowledge, developing talent, seeking diverse perspectives, and maintaining accountability for collective outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of drug development and demonstrated ability to critically evaluate clinical and scientific evidence.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing integrated medical and evidence-generation plans, translating evidence gaps into feasible study concepts, critically interpreting results, and partnering with methodological experts and scientific communications colleagues on dissemination.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish trusted scientific partnerships with medical experts and other stakeholders.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including interpersonal communication and presentations.

The candidate should be able to manage multiple campaign testing cycles, identify performance issues, follow up appropriately, and escalate concerns when needed.

This is a fully remote independent contractor opportunity for candidates based in the Philippines. At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

jobs.description:
Role Overview

Overheard is launching Overheard Sports, and we're looking for a freelance Content Creator to help build it from day one. This person will ideate, write, produce, and publish daily static and short video content that covers the biggest moments in sports through a relatable, cultural, and entertainment-first lens. Think less box scores, more group chat: the viral sideline moment, the halftime show discourse, the athlete fit check, the fan who caught the foul ball with her beer, and the collective meltdown when a franchise does something inexplicable.

This is a write-it-and-make-it role: you'll own every post end to end, from the idea and the copy to the finished meme, graphic, or edit, working across written editorial, low-lift video, and supporting formats to launch the Overheard Sports feed and grow it into a go-to destination for people who love sports culture, including those who care more about the storylines than the stats. This is a freelance role ideal for someone who lives and breathes sports and internet culture, moves fast, and can turn any game-day moment into scroll-stopping, shareable content.

You'll collaborate closely with the Editor, Social Leads, and the broader Overheard team, helping shape the page's identity, contributing ideas in pitch meetings, building new formats, and upholding brand consistency across platforms.

Responsibilities

Launch + Grow the Page

  • Help define the voice, content pillars, and visual identity of Overheard Sports ahead of and through launch.
  • Build a consistent posting cadence that establishes the page as a daily, reliable source of sports culture content.
  • Develop and test recurring formats and franchises that give audiences a reason to follow, return, and share.
  • Track performance and iterate quickly, doubling down on what's working to drive follower growth, shares, and saves.

Publish Daily Sports Content

  • Write and publish original, on-voice content for Overheard Sports every day, with a focus on shareability.
  • Cover the big moments across major leagues and events (NFL, NBA, F1, WNBA, soccer, college sports, the Olympics, and more) through a cultural and comedic lens.
  • Write sharp, witty, brand-aligned captions, headlines, copy, and scripts in the Overheard voice, tailored to sports and pop culture audiences.
  • Move quickly on live and breaking moments during games, drafts, trades, awards shows, and tentpole events so the page is part of the conversation in real time.

Audience Insights + Strategy

  • Identify what the Overheard Sports audience cares about: the athletes, teams, rivalries, storylines, and crossover moments that spark conversation.
  • Monitor comments, trends, and platformance analytics to surface audience interests and turn those insights into content ideas.
  • Spot emerging sports-culture conversations early, from athlete fashion and celebrity courtside sightings to fan behavior and viral memes.
  • Share learnings with the Editor and Social team to inform content strategy and growth priorities.

Design + Production

  • Fully produce the content you write, not just the copy: you'll take each post from idea to finished, ready-to-publish asset.
  • Design memes, graphics, carousels, and text-based posts in Canva (or similar), keeping them clean, fast, and on-brand.
  • Shoot, edit, and package low-lift short-form videos using an iPhone or consumer-grade equipment.
  • Maintain a nimble, social-first production style that matches Overheard's pace and aesthetic.

Content Ideation + Development

  • Bring fresh ideas to pitch meetings for editorial posts, video franchises, and comedic formats rooted in sports culture.
  • Plan ahead for the sports calendar (season openers, playoffs, drafts, the Super Bowl, March Madness, and more) while staying flexible for the unexpected.

Brand + Voice Stewardship

  • Uphold Overheard's tone, POV, aesthetics, and writing style across every asset.
  • Stay on top of internet culture, trending humor formats, and sports discourse to keep the account relevant and timely.
  • Partner with Creative, Social, and Editorial teams to support the launch, cross-promotion across the Overheard network, and content experiments.

Quality + Process

  • Maintain high editorial standards for accuracy, clarity, and comedic alignment, including getting the sports details right.
  • Stay organized across a fast-moving content pipeline and deliver on deadlines, including occasional evenings and weekends around key games and events.
  • Contribute to evolving best practices and creative playbooks as Overheard Sports grows.

Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of experience in editorial, social content creation, sports media, publishing, entertainment, or a similar creative field.
  • Exceptional writing skills with a comedic sensibility, able to nail Overheard's specific voice (quick, sharp, observational, irreverent, but never try-hard).
  • Deep familiarity with sports and sports culture across multiple leagues, plus the conversations female fans are having about them online.
  • Experience launching or growing a social account is a strong plus; able to show examples of content or pages you've helped build.
  • Proven ability to ideate and execute social-first content across Instagram and TikTok.
  • Comfortable using analytics and audience signals to guide content decisions.
  • Able to fully produce your own content: design memes, graphics, and carousels in Canva (or similar), and ideally able to shoot and edit video on iPhone or consumer-grade equipment. No formal design background needed, just a good eye and speed.
  • Strong understanding of meme culture and internet trends, and how to translate big sports moments into content that people want to send to their friends.
  • Highly organized, able to manage multiple content streams and hit deadlines independently, with flexibility to cover live events.
  • Collaborative and communicative, excited to pitch, brainstorm, and build new formats.
  • Bonus: familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut, or other lightweight video editing tools.

Engagement Details

  • Freelance / permalance; hours and cadence to be scoped with the Editor based on content volume and the sports calendar.
  • Remote-friendly. NYC preferred.

jobs.title: Customer Experience SysOps Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Every hotel and holiday park we serve relies on a support team that can answer quickly.
jobs.description:
Every hotel and holiday park we serve relies on a support team that can answer quickly. Behind that team is a stack of systems someone has to keep sharp. This is that someone.

The opportunityThis is a new role. Our CX function is growing and its systems need a dedicated owner. Some reporting is repeatable; plenty else is still to be built. If you like roles where the answer hasn't already been decided for you, you'll probably enjoy this one.

Why you'll enjoy this role
Real ownership. You're the only person running these platforms, so how they work is largely your call.
Fix the cause. You'll trace bad data back to its source process, so the clean-up sticks.
Visible impact. Leaders will make decisions from your reports and dashboards.

What you'll take on
  • Configure and run Zendesk, ChurnZero and GuideCX, and bring Zendesk configuration work in-house.
  • Own monthly churn reporting end to end, from data pull to leadership pack.
  • Investigate ad hoc questions, like a ticket spike, and report back on the likely cause.
  • Clean dirty data that blocks playbooks and reporting, then fix the process that created it.
  • Use AI and automation to cut manual work, checking every output against source data.

The team you'll join
You'll join our Customer Experience team and work with Customer Success, Support and Implementations.

What you'll bring
Equivalent tools are fine. You'll likely have:
  • SaaS experience in CX operations, CS operations or systems administration.
  • Configuration experience with a support platform (Zendesk, Intercom) and a customer success platform.
  • Fluency in churn, net revenue retention and support metrics, and why they matter.
  • Strong data skills: cleaning bulk data and building dashboards in Power BI or similar.
  • Confident daily AI use, with the discipline to fact-check output and explain it.
  • Comfort juggling several stakeholders, and working Australian business hours.
Direct ChurnZero, GuideCX or Zendesk experience would be useful, but it isn't essential. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway. A job description is a wish list, not a checklist.

How we work
We've designed different ways of working because not every role, team or location needs the same setup.
Across RMS, every role sits within one of our work modes. It's a flexible, multi-modal framework: trust-based, role-driven and outcomes-focused. Every mode includes meaningful flexibility and remote working, alongside clear expectations about how we stay connected as a global team.

For this role, you'll work within our Region-Based mode, remote-first from the Philippines, with coworking access and travel to customers when needed. Wherever we work from, connection matters. We're async-first: we use tools like Slack to stay close to our teams, share context, make decisions and collaborate across locations and time zones.

AI is also becoming part of how we work across RMS. We expect everyone to build a level of AI fluency relevant to their role, using the technology thoughtfully to improve how they work, solve problems and create better outcomes. What that looks like will vary by role, and it will continue to evolve as we do.

Life at RMS
RMS is a global hospitality technology company helping operators run better businesses and create better experiences for their guests.

We're ambitious about where the product and business are going, and the way we work continues to evolve alongside them.

A few things worth knowing:
  • We value ownership. You'll have room to make decisions, and we expect people to take responsibility for moving things forward.
  • Not everything comes with a playbook. We're continuing to improve our products, processes and ways of working. You'll sometimes need to create clarity rather than wait for it.
  • We stay curious. Whether it's AI, new technology or simply a better way of solving an old problem, we want people who are willing to experiment, learn and share what works.
  • We're global. You'll work with people, customers and partners across multiple regions, so thoughtful communication and collaboration matter.
  • We care about outcomes. Ideas are valuable, but turning them into something that improves the experience for our customers, our teams or our business is what really counts.
And you can be yourself here. We're an equal opportunities employer, made up of people with different backgrounds, experiences, personalities and perspectives. That mix makes better ideas and better products for customers all over the world, and it means there isn't one type of person who fits at RMS.

Our values are simple: Committed to customer.Honest words, trusted actions. Push boundaries, stay curious. Own it, make it happen.

What's in it for you
Alongside meaningful ownership, flexible ways of working and the opportunity to contribute to a global SaaS business, everyone at RMS has access to benefits designed to support their development and wellbeing.

Our global benefits include:
  • Learning platform with thousands of tailored learning pathways to support your own development plan.
  • Employee Assistance Program: free, confidential support for you and your family, whenever you need it.
  • Rise, our annual kick-off event that brings the whole of RMS together to connect, celebrate and set up the year ahead.
  • Years of Service awards, social events and RMS swag, because the moments between the work matter too.

  • 高度な数学スキル
